// ESPN's calendar is a list of game days ("2026-11-02T08:00Z") for most sports, and a list of weeks for football.
function gameDays(L){
  const out = [];
  const add = (s, e) => { const a = Date.parse(s), b = Date.parse(e||s); if(!isNaN(a)) out.push([a, isNaN(b)?a:b]); };
  for(const c of L?.calendar||[]){
    if(typeof c === "string") add(c);
    else for(const w of c.entries||[c]) add(w.startDate, w.endDate);
  }
  return out;
}
async function checkSeason(id){
  const L = LEAGUES[id];
  try{
    const d = await getJSON(`${ESPN}${L.path}/scoreboard?${L.groups?`groups=${L.groups}&`:""}${id==="fb"?"groups=80&":""}limit=900`);
    const lg = (d.leagues||[])[0] || {}, now = Date.now(), day = 864e5;
    const days = gameDays(lg);
    const evDays = (d.events||[]).map(e=>Date.parse(e.date)).filter(t=>!isNaN(t));
    const soon = [...days.map(r=>r[0]), ...evDays].filter(t => t >= now - day/2).sort((a,b)=>a-b)[0];
    const recent = [...days.map(r=>r[1]), ...evDays].some(t => t <= now + day/2 && t >= now - 3*day);
    const within = days.some(([a,b]) => b >= now - 3*day && a <= now + 7*day) || evDays.some(t => t >= now - 3*day && t <= now + 7*day);
    // Not started yet: nothing in the last month, first game day is coming up within the week.
    const played = [...days.map(r=>r[0]), ...evDays].some(t => t < now - day/2 && t > now - 30*day);
    const starts = within && !played && !recent && soon ? soon : null;
    SEASON[id] = {on: within, starts, live: (d.events||[]).filter(e=>e.status?.type?.state==="in").length,
      today: (d.events||[]).filter(e=>new Date(e.date).toDateString()===new Date().toDateString()).length, at: now};
  }catch(e){ if(!SEASON[id]) SEASON[id] = {on: id==="fb", live:0, today:0, at: Date.now(), failed:true}; }
}
async function checkSeasons(){
  await Promise.all(Object.keys(LEAGUES).map(checkSeason));
  // Keep the sport you picked last time if it's still in season; otherwise football, then whatever's on.
  if(!checkSeasons.done){
    checkSeasons.done = true;
    const want = store.get("sport");
    const on = id => SEASON[id]?.on;
    const pick = (want && LEAGUES[want] && on(want)) ? want
      : on("fb") ? "fb"
      : Object.keys(LEAGUES).filter(on).sort((a,b)=>(SEASON[b].live-SEASON[a].live) || (SEASON[b].today-SEASON[a].today))[0] || "fb";
    if(pick !== SPORT.id) setSport(pick, true);
  }
  renderSports();
}

function renderSports(){
  const box = $("#sports"), seg = $("#gender");
  const tiles = TILES.map(t=>({...t, leagues: tileLeagues(t.id)})).filter(t=>t.leagues.length);
  // Only one sport in season: no tile row at all, the page looks like it always did.
  box.hidden = tiles.length < 2;
  const x = box.scrollLeft;
  box.innerHTML = tiles.map(t=>{
    const sel = t.id === SPORT.tile;
    const live = t.leagues.reduce((n,L)=>n + (SEASON[L.id]?.live||0), 0);
    const today = t.leagues.reduce((n,L)=>n + (SEASON[L.id]?.today||0), 0);
    const st = t.leagues.map(L=>SEASON[L.id]?.starts).filter(Boolean).sort()[0];
    const sub = live ? `● ${live} live` : st && !today ? `Starts ${new Date(st).toLocaleDateString([], {month:"short", day:"numeric"})}` : today ? `${today} today` : "";
    return `<button class="sport ${st && !live && !today ? "soon" : ""}" role="tab" data-tile="${t.id}" aria-selected="${sel}"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">${t.icon}</svg><span class="nm">${t.name}</span><span class="sub ${live?"lv":""}">${sub}</span></button>`;
  }).join("");

function oddsFor(e){

  const H = oddsKey(h.displayName), A = oddsKey(a.displayName);
  // odds.json covers football, men's and women's basketball and baseball (older files: football only).
  const ODDS_S = ODDS.filter(g => (g.sport || "fb") === SPORT.id);
  return ODDS_S.find(g=>oddsKey(g.home)===H && oddsKey(g.away)===A)
      || ODDS_S.find(g=>Math.abs(Date.parse(g.start)-t0) < 3600e3 && (oddsKey(g.home)===H || oddsKey(g.away)===A))
      // Sportsbooks write "Michigan St Spartans" where ESPN has "Michigan State Spartans": same start time and both nicknames.
      || ODDS_S.find(g=>Math.abs(Date.parse(g.start)-t0) < 3*3600e3 && nick(g.home)===nick(h.displayName) && nick(g.away)===nick(a.displayName));
}
// Pick up stream fixes and game-day feeds without a page refresh (the team you're listening to keeps playing).
async function refreshDirectory(){
  try{
    try{ playback = await getJSON("playback.json?t=" + Math.floor(Date.now()/120000)); }catch(e){}
    const d = await getJSON("radio.json?t=" + Math.floor(Date.now()/120000));
    dirIndex.clear();
    for(const t of d.teams||[]) for(const n of [t.school, ...(t.names||[])]) if(n && !dirIndex.has(normName(n))) dirIndex.set(normName(n), t);
    for(const k of Object.keys(RADIO)) delete RADIO[k];
    for(const k of Object.keys(RADIO_INFO)) delete RADIO_INFO[k];
    for(const k of Object.keys(ready)) delete ready[k];
    events.forEach(e=>e.competitions[0].competitors.forEach(c=>attachRadio(c.team)));
    render();
  }catch(e){}
}
async function loadDirectory(){
  await loadLive(); setInterval(loadLive, 10*60*1000);
  loadOdds(); setInterval(loadOdds, 15*60*1000);
  loadStreaks(); setInterval(loadStreaks, 60*60*1000);
  try{
    try{ playback = await getJSON("playback.json?t=" + Math.floor(Date.now()/300000)); }catch(e){}
    const d = await getJSON("radio.json?t=" + Math.floor(Date.now()/120000));
    for(const t of d.teams||[]) for(const n of [t.school, ...(t.names||[])]) if(n && !dirIndex.has(normName(n))) dirIndex.set(normName(n), t);
    if(!loadDirectory.timer) loadDirectory.timer = setInterval(()=>{ if(!document.hidden || deck) refreshDirectory(); }, 10*60*1000);
    events.forEach(e=>e.competitions[0].competitors.forEach(c=>attachRadio(c.team)));
    render(); fillStations();
  }catch(e){ /* no directory yet: hand-checked teams still work */ }
}
let playback = {streams:{}, teams:{}};
const SECURE_PAGE = location.protocol === "https:";
function orderStreams(school, streams, feeds){
  const pb = playback.teams?.[school] || {}, res = playback.streams || {};
  const isFeed = u => (feeds||[]).includes(u); // school game feeds only exist during games, so a failed test outside one means nothing
  const key = u => u.replace(/^https?:\/\//,"").replace(/:\d+\//,"/");
  // Keep the directory's order (official game feeds first). The playback test may have found a
  // secure (https) version of a stream: use it in that stream's place. Streams the test knows
  // failed in a page, or that would be blocked as plain http, go last.
  const all = [];
  streams.forEach((u, i) => {
    const variants = (pb.inpage||[]).filter(v => key(v) === key(u) && v !== u);
    [...variants, u].forEach(v => { if(!all.some(x=>x.u===v)) all.push({u: v, i}); });
  });
  const hard = u => (res[u]?.ok === false && !isFeed(u)) ? 3 : (SECURE_PAGE && u.startsWith("http:")) ? 4 : 0;
  // Game-time checks (per sport): streams heard carrying something else, or blocked, are left out.
  const playable = all
    .filter(x => !(SECURE_PAGE && x.u.startsWith("http:")) && liveVerdict(x.u)?.verdict !== "blocked" && !["blocked","not_game"].includes(heard(x.u)))
    .sort((a,b) => hard(a.u)-hard(b.u) || vRank(a.u)-vRank(b.u) || a.i-b.i)
    .map(x => x.u);
  const external = pb.external || streams.find(u=>u.startsWith("http:")) || null;
  return {playable, external};
}
function attachRadio(tm){
  if(!tm || RADIO[tm.location] || !dirIndex.size) return;
  const tries = [tm.location, tm.displayName, `${tm.location} ${tm.name||""}`, tm.shortDisplayName, tm.abbreviation];
  let hit = null; for(const n of tries){ hit = dirIndex.get(normName(n)); if(hit) break; }
  // School game feeds are found per sport at game time; only use them for the sport they were found for.
  const feedsMine = (hit?.game_feeds_sport || "fb") === SPORT.id;
  const feeds = feedsMine ? (hit?.game_feeds||[]) : [];
  // Main sports stations carry football and basketball (and usually hockey), but almost never volleyball,
  // baseball or softball. For those, use the station only where we know it carries the sport;
  // otherwise only the school's own game feed.
  const stationOK = !STATION_OPT_IN.has(SPORT.id) || (hit?.station_sports||[]).includes(SPORT.id) || !!carries[`${SPORT.id}|${hit?.school}`];
  // Some schools put one sport on its own station (Wisconsin volleyball on ESPN Madison, Stanford's on KZSU).
  const own = hit?.sport_streams?.[SPORT.id] || [];
  const streams = [...new Set([...(feedsMine ? (hit?.game_feeds||[]) : []), ...own, ...(hit?.streams||[]).filter(u => (hit.game_feeds||[]).includes(u) ? feedsMine : stationOK && !own.length)])];
  if(!hit || !streams.length){ if(hit) RADIO_INFO[tm.location] = stationOK ? hit : {...hit, sportFeedOnly: true}; return; }
  const {playable, external} = orderStreams(hit.school, streams, feeds);
  RADIO[tm.location] = own.length
    ? {net: hit.sport_station?.[SPORT.id] || `${tm.location} ${SPORT.name.toLowerCase()} radio`, station: hit.sport_station?.[SPORT.id] || "", streams: playable, external, listen: hit.listen_page || ""}
    : stationOK
    ? {net: hit.network || `${tm.location} radio`, station: hit.flagship || "", streams: playable, external, listen: hit.listen_page || ""}
    : {net: `${tm.location} ${SPORT.name.toLowerCase()} audio`, station: "School broadcast", streams: playable, external, listen: hit.athletics_site || ""};
}
const RADIO_INFO = {}; // teams we know about but have no free stream for
const STATION_OPT_IN = new Set(["wvb", "bsb", "sb"]);
// School-run feeds that only exist around game time (picked up ~20 minutes before the game starts).
function gameTimeOnly(loc){ const i = RADIO_INFO[loc]; return !!(i && i.game_only && !(i.streams||[]).filter(u=>!(i.game_feeds||[]).includes(u)).length); }
// No station known, but the school has an athletics site: the game-time finder checks it from 3 hours before the start.
function feedMaybe(loc){ const i = RADIO_INFO[loc]; return !!(i && !i.game_only && i.athletics_site && (i.sportFeedOnly || (!i.no_radio && !(i.calls||[]).length))); }
const waitsForFeed = loc => gameTimeOnly(loc) || feedMaybe(loc);
const feedText = (loc, live) => gameTimeOnly(loc)
  ? (live ? "comes from the school's own feed and should appear within a few minutes" : `goes live about 20 minutes before ${SPORT.start}`)
  : (live ? "may come from the school's own feed; still looking" : `may come from the school's own feed near ${SPORT.start}`);
function soonNote(e){
  const ts = e.competitions[0].competitors.map(c=>c.team);
  const has = t => !!(RADIO[t.location]?.streams?.length || RADIO[t.location]?.external || store.get("stream:"+t.location));
  if(ts.some(has)) {
    // one side has radio; still mention a school feed that's on its way
    // (a school that only might have a feed isn't worth a note when the other side has radio)
    const soon = ts.filter(t=>!has(t) && gameTimeOnly(t.location) && !feedLate(e));
    return soon.length ? note(`${soon.map(t=>esc(nameOf(t))).join(" and ")} radio ${feedText(soon[0].location, e.status.type.state==="in")}.`) : "";
  }
  const soon = ts.filter(t=>waitsForFeed(t.location) && !feedLate(e));
  if(soon.length){ const live = e.status.type.state==="in", txt = [...new Set(soon.map(t=>feedText(t.location, live)))];
    return note(txt.length===1 ? `${soon.map(t=>esc(nameOf(t))).join(" and ")} radio ${txt[0]}.` : soon.map(t=>`${esc(nameOf(t))} radio ${feedText(t.location, live)}.`).join(" "), gameTimeOnly(soon[0].location) ? "" : "maybe"); }
  return note("No free radio for this game", "off slim");
}
// School feeds that still haven't shown up 25 minutes after kickoff probably aren't coming.
function lateFor(loc){ const e = events.find(x=>x.competitions[0].competitors.some(c=>c.team.location===loc)); return !!(e && feedLate(e)); }
// Only show a real down-and-distance ("3rd & 4 at HC 30"); around scores and kickoffs ESPN sometimes sends fragments like "& Goal at HC 3".
function goodDD(t){ return /^(1st|2nd|3rd|4th)\b/i.test((t||"").trim()); }
function feedLate(e){ return e.status.type.state==="in" && Date.now() - Date.parse(e.date) > 25*60e3; }
function note(text, kind){
  const icon = String(kind||"").includes("off")
    ? `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 15v-3a8 8 0 0 1 13.7-5.6M20 12v3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M3 3l18 18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>`
    : `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M12 7v5l3 2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>`;
  return `<div class="soon-note ${kind||""}">${icon}<span>${text}</span></div>`;
}
let divFilter = /^(all|T25|fav|c:.+)$/.test(store.get("div")||"") ? store.get("div") : "all", query = "";
const favs = new Set((()=>{try{return JSON.parse(store.get("favs")||"[]")}catch(e){return []}})());
function saveFavs(){ store.set("favs", JSON.stringify([...favs])); }
const isFavGame = e => e.competitions[0].competitors.some(t=>favs.has(t.team.location));
const isTop25 = e => e.competitions[0].competitors.some(t=>t.curatedRank?.current && t.curatedRank.current < 26);
// Ranked games still to come this week (the same window as the day tabs), soonest first.
const upcomingTop25 = () => events.filter(e=>e.status.type.state==="pre" && new Date(e.date) - Date.now() < 8*864e5 && isTop25(e)).sort((a,b)=>new Date(a.date)-new Date(b.date));
/* Live list order: close games near the end first, then games with a Top 25 team, then the rest
   (each group by start time). A game only moves when it crosses one of these lines. */
function crunch(e){
  const st = e.status||{}, p = st.period||0, clk = st.clock||0, [x,y] = e.competitions[0].competitors.map(t=>Number(t.score)||0), d = Math.abs(x-y);
  switch(SPORT.id){
    case "fb":  return p>=4 && d<=8;
    case "mbb": return (p>2 || (p===2 && clk<=300)) && d<=8;
    case "wbb": return (p>4 || (p===4 && clk<=300)) && d<=8;
    case "mhk": case "whk": return p>=3 && d<=1;
    case "bsb": return p>=7 && d<=2;
    case "sb":  return p>=5 && d<=2;
  }
  return false;
}
const liveRank = e => crunch(e) ? 0 : isTop25(e) ? 1 : 2;
const divOK = e => divFilter==="all" || (divFilter==="fav" ? isFavGame(e) : divFilter==="T25" ? isTop25(e)
  : divFilter.startsWith("c:") ? gameConfs(e).includes(divFilter.slice(2)) : true);
// A game's conference for grouping (the home team's, else the visitor's), and every conference it counts for in a filter.
function groupConf(e){
  const c = e.competitions[0], h = team(c,"home"), a = team(c,"away");
  return confOf(h.team) || confOf(a.team) || (e._div==="FCS" ? "FCS" : isFB() ? "Other" : "Other games");
}
const gameConfs = e => { const c = e.competitions[0]; return [...new Set([confOf(team(c,"home").team), confOf(team(c,"away").team), groupConf(e)].filter(Boolean))]; };
// Major conferences first, then the rest A-Z, games with no conference last.
const confRank = n => { const i = POWER[isFB() ? "fb" : SPORT.tile]?.indexOf(n) ?? -1; return n==="Other games" || n==="Other" ? 2e3 : i >= 0 ? i : 1e3; };
const byConf = (x, y) => confRank(x)-confRank(y) || x.localeCompare(y);
// Chips: All, Top 25, Saved, then each conference playing today (or on the day being shown).
function renderChips(pool, live){
  const base = live.length ? live : pool, n = f => { const k = base.filter(f).length; return k ? String(k) : ""; };
  // Major conferences, then ones with games live now (busiest first), then the rest A-Z.
  const liveIn = c => live.filter(e=>groupConf(e)===c).length, major = c => confRank(c) < 1e3;
  let confs = [...new Set(pool.map(groupConf))].sort((x, y)=> (major(y)-major(x)) || (major(x) ? 0 : liveIn(y)-liveIn(x)) || byConf(x, y));
  if(confs.length===1 && /^Other/.test(confs[0])) confs = [];
  if(divFilter.startsWith("c:")) divFilter = "all"; // conference chips were removed; conferences are the bars below
  // Top 25 carried over from another sport, but no ranked games here this week (no Top 25 chip): fall back to All.
  if(divFilter==="T25" && pool.length && !pool.some(isTop25) && (live.length || !upcomingTop25().length)) divFilter = "all";
  const chip = (div, label, count, aria) => `<button class="chip" data-div="${esc(div)}" aria-pressed="${divFilter===div}"${aria?` aria-label="${aria}"`:""}>${esc(label)}<span class="n">${count}</span></button>`;
  const html = chip("all", "All", String(base.length||"")) + (pool.some(isTop25) || (!live.length && upcomingTop25().length) ? chip("T25", "Top 25", n(isTop25)) : "") + chip("fav", "★ Saved", n(isFavGame), "Saved teams")
;
  const box = $("#chips"); if(box.dataset.html !== html){ const x = box.scrollLeft; box.innerHTML = html; box.dataset.html = html; box.scrollLeft = x; }
}
// Live conference bars start open (and "More conferences" closed); folding one is remembered.
const liveShut = n => confOpen.has(confKey(n, "live")) !== (n === "More conferences");
const setLiveShut = (n, shut) => { if(shut !== (n === "More conferences")) confOpen.add(confKey(n, "live")); else confOpen.delete(confKey(n, "live")); };
function fmtTime(d){return new Date(d).toLocaleString([], {weekday:"short", hour:"numeric", minute:"2-digit", hour12:true})}
function now12(){return new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:"numeric",minute:"2-digit",second:"2-digit",hour12:true})}

// Every request gives up after 9 seconds (stadium cell service can hang for a minute otherwise).
async function getJSON(u, ms=9000){
  const ac = new AbortController(), t = setTimeout(()=>ac.abort(), ms);
  try{ const r = await fetch(u, {cache:"no-store", signal: ac.signal}); if(!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status); return await r.json(); }
  finally{ clearTimeout(t); }
}
// Status line: "Updated 3:04 PM", or a warning once the last good update is more than 30 seconds old.
let lastOk = 0;
function scoresOk(){ lastOk = Date.now(); $("#dot").className = "dot ok"; $("#stat").textContent = "Updated " + new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:"numeric", minute:"2-digit", hour12:true}); $("#upd").textContent = ""; }
function scoresFailed(){
  $("#dot").className = "dot err";
  $("#stat").textContent = lastOk ? `Scores may be delayed · last update ${new Date(lastOk).toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:"numeric", minute:"2-digit", hour12:true})}` : "Can't reach the scores feed right now. Retrying…";
  if(!history.length) setList(`<div class="empty">Can't reach the scores feed right now. Retrying…</div>`);
}
setInterval(()=>{ if(lastOk && Date.now() - lastOk > 30000 && !document.hidden) scoresFailed(); }, 10000);
/* How often scores refresh. Full speed only while you're watching a live game; slower otherwise,
   and much slower when the page isn't on screen (just enough to keep the lock screen current). */
function pollGap(){
  const live = events.some(e=>e.status.type.state==="in"), playing = !!deck && !audio.paused;
  if(document.hidden) return playing ? 15000 : 120000;
  if(!live) return 30000;
  return (playing || (selected && boardOpen)) ? 6000 : 12000;
}
// One refresh at a time: a slow response can never land after a newer one.
async function pollLoop(){
  clearTimeout(pollLoop.t);
  if(pollLoop.busy){ pollLoop.again = true; return; }
  pollLoop.busy = true;
  try{ await poll(); fillStations(); } catch(e){}
  finally{
    pollLoop.busy = false;
    if(pollLoop.again){ pollLoop.again = false; setTimeout(pollLoop, 0); }
    else pollLoop.t = setTimeout(pollLoop, pollGap());
  }
}
document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", ()=>{ if(!document.hidden && Date.now() - lastOk > 5000) pollLoop(); });

async function poll(){
  if(!isFB()) return pollOther();
  const tok = sportTok;
  try{
    const [fbs, fcs] = await Promise.all([
      getJSON(`${base}/scoreboard?groups=80&limit=400`),
      // If FCS fails once, keep the last good list rather than having every FCS game vanish.
      getJSON(`${base}/scoreboard?groups=81&limit=400`).then(x=>(poll.lastFcs = x)).catch(()=>poll.lastFcs || {events:[]}),
    ]);
    const byId = new Map();
    (fbs.events||[]).forEach(e=>{ e._div = "FBS"; byId.set(e.id, e); });
    (fcs.events||[]).forEach(e=>{ if(!byId.has(e.id)){ e._div = "FCS"; byId.set(e.id, e); } });
    // The default scoreboard only covers the current game week (and on Sundays/Mondays still shows
    // last week), so also load the next 8 days of the schedule for the upcoming list (every 15 minutes).
    {
      const wk = fbs.week?.number, st = fbs.season?.type || 2;
      if(wk && (!poll.ahead || Date.now()-poll.ahead.t > 15*60e3 || poll.ahead.wk !== wk)){
        // ESPN doesn't take date ranges, but it does take a week number: load next week too.
        const [f2, c2] = await Promise.all([80,81].map(g=>getJSON(`${base}/scoreboard?groups=${g}&limit=400&week=${wk+1}&seasontype=${st}`).catch(()=>({events:[]}))));
        if(tok !== sportTok) return; // switched sports while this was loading: don't overwrite the new sport's week
        poll.ahead = {t: Date.now(), wk, f: f2.events||[], c: c2.events||[]};
      }
      if(!poll.ahead) poll.ahead = {t: 0, f: [], c: []};
      poll.ahead.f.forEach(e=>{ if(!byId.has(e.id)){ e._div = "FBS"; byId.set(e.id, e); } });
      poll.ahead.c.forEach(e=>{ if(!byId.has(e.id)){ e._div = "FCS"; byId.set(e.id, e); } });
    }
    if(tok !== sportTok) return; // switched sports while this was loading
    const evs = freshen([...byId.values()]);
    evs.forEach(e=>e.competitions[0].competitors.forEach(c=>attachRadio(c.team))); noteScores(evs);
    history.push({t:Date.now(), evs}); history = history.filter(h => Date.now()-h.t < (delay+20)*1000);
    scoresOk();
    const live = evs.filter(e=>e.status.type.state==="in");
    // Play-by-play only for the game you have open and the one on the radio (every 6 seconds), and
    // saved teams' games (every minute, for their details when you open them). Each team's radio is
    // looked up ahead of time so Listen starts right away.
    live.forEach(e=>{
      const mine = e.id===selected || (deck && e.competitions[0].competitors.some(c=>c.team.location===deck.loc));
      if(mine) pollSummary(e.id, 6000); else if(isFavGame(e)) pollSummary(e.id, 60000);
      e.competitions[0].competitors.forEach(t=>prepareTeam(t.team.location));
    });
  }catch(e){
    if(tok !== sportTok) return;
    scoresFailed();
  }
  render();
}
// Basketball, hockey, volleyball, baseball, softball: today's scoreboard every few seconds, plus each
// upcoming game day in the next week (from ESPN's calendar) every 15 minutes. ESPN won't take date ranges.
async function pollOther(){
  const tok = sportTok, L = SPORT, g = L.groups ? `groups=${L.groups}&` : "";
  try{
    const d = await getJSON(`${base}/scoreboard?${g}limit=900`);
    if(tok !== sportTok) return;
    const byId = new Map();
    (d.events||[]).forEach(e=>{ e._div = ""; byId.set(e.id, e); });
    // In the morning ESPN's default scoreboard is still on yesterday. Today's games then come from
    // their own date (at full refresh speed), not the 15-minute background load of the week.
    const todayK = ymd(Date.now());
    const gamesToday = gameDays((d.leagues||[])[0]).some(([a])=>new Date(a).toISOString().slice(0,10).replace(/-/g,"")===todayK);
    if(!(d.events||[]).some(e=>ymd(e.date)===todayK) && gamesToday){
      try{ const t = await getJSON(`${base}/scoreboard?${g}dates=${todayK}&limit=900`); if(tok !== sportTok) return;
        (t.events||[]).forEach(e=>{ e._div = ""; byId.set(e.id, e); }); }catch(e){}
    }
    // The rest of the week loads in the background so today's games show right away.
    if(!poll.loading && (!poll.ahead || Date.now()-poll.ahead.t > 15*60e3)){
      const now = Date.now(), have = new Set([...byId.values()].map(e=>ymd(e.date)));
      const days = [...new Set(gameDays((d.leagues||[])[0]).map(r=>r[0]).filter(t=>t > now - 864e5/2 && t < now + 8*864e5).map(t=>new Date(t).toISOString().slice(0,10).replace(/-/g,"")))]
        .filter(k=>!have.has(k)).slice(0, 8);
      poll.loading = true;
      if(!poll.ahead) poll.ahead = {t: 0, byDay: {}};
      // Each day shows up (with its day tab) as soon as it arrives, instead of waiting for the whole week.
      Promise.all(days.map(k=>getJSON(`${base}/scoreboard?${g}dates=${k}&limit=900`)
          .then(x=>{ if(tok !== sportTok) return; poll.ahead.byDay[k] = x.events||[]; addAhead(x.events||[]); })
          .catch(()=>{})))
        .then(()=>{ if(tok === sportTok) poll.ahead.t = Date.now(); })
        .finally(()=>{ poll.loading = false; });
    }
    Object.values(poll.ahead?.byDay||{}).flat().forEach(e=>{ if(!byId.has(e.id)){ e._div = ""; byId.set(e.id, e); } });
    const evs = freshen([...byId.values()]);
    evs.forEach(e=>e.competitions[0].competitors.forEach(c=>attachRadio(c.team))); noteScores(evs);
    history.push({t:Date.now(), evs}); history = history.filter(h => Date.now()-h.t < (delay+20)*1000);
    scoresOk();
    // Only the open game and the one on the radio get play-by-play (a basketball night can have 150 games).
    evs.filter(e=>e.status.type.state==="in").forEach(e=>{
      const onAir = deck && e.competitions[0].competitors.some(c=>c.team.location===deck.loc);
      if(e.id===selected || onAir) pollSummary(e.id, 6000);
      e.competitions[0].competitors.forEach(t=>prepareTeam(t.team.location));
    });
    const s = SEASON[L.id]; if(s){ const live = evs.filter(e=>e.status.type.state==="in").length; if(s.live !== live){ s.live = live; renderSports(); } }
  }catch(e){
    if(tok !== sportTok) return;
    scoresFailed();
  }
  render();
}
// A day of the coming week just loaded: add its games to the latest snapshot and redraw right away.
function addAhead(more){
  const last = history[history.length-1]; if(!last) return;
  const ids = new Set(last.evs.map(e=>e.id)), add = more.filter(e=>!ids.has(e.id));
  if(!add.length) return;
  add.forEach(e=>{ e._div = ""; e.competitions[0].competitors.forEach(c=>attachRadio(c.team)); });
  history.push({t: Date.now(), evs: [...last.evs, ...add]});
  render();
}
/* Faster updates for the game you have open and the one on the radio. ESPN's single-game feed is
   small (about 9 KB) and refreshed every second, while the full scoreboard is large and cached for
   about 6 seconds. So those one or two games are checked every 2.5 seconds on their own, and the
   full scoreboard keeps the fresher copy when it arrives a little behind. */
const FAST = {}; // game id -> {t, ev}
let fastBusy = false;
function freshen(evs){
  return evs.map(e=>{ const f = FAST[e.id]; if(!f || Date.now() - f.t > 6000) return e; f.ev._div = e._div; return f.ev; });
}
async function fastPoll(){
  if(document.hidden || fastBusy) return;
  const live = events.filter(e=>e.status.type.state==="in"), ids = new Set();
  if(selected && boardOpen && live.some(e=>e.id===selected)) ids.add(selected);
  if(deck){ const g = live.find(e=>e.competitions[0].competitors.some(c=>c.team.location===deck.loc)); if(g) ids.add(g.id); }
  if(!ids.size) return;
  fastBusy = true; const tok = sportTok;
  try{
    for(const id of ids){
      const ev = await getJSON(`${base}/scoreboard/${id}`, 5000);
      if(tok !== sportTok || !ev?.competitions) return;
      const last = history[history.length-1], old = last?.evs.find(x=>x.id===id); if(!old) continue;
      FAST[id] = {t: Date.now(), ev};
      const sig = x => JSON.stringify([x.status, x.competitions[0].situation, x.competitions[0].competitors.map(c=>[c.score, c.linescores])]);
      if(sig(old) === sig(ev)) continue;
      ev._div = old._div; ev.competitions[0].competitors.forEach(c=>attachRadio(c.team)); noteScores([ev]);
      history.push({t: Date.now(), evs: last.evs.map(x=>x.id===id ? ev : x)});
      history = history.filter(h => Date.now()-h.t < (delay+20)*1000);
      render();
    }
  }catch(e){} finally{ fastBusy = false; }
}
setInterval(fastPoll, 2500);
const sumAt = {};
async function pollSummary(id, gap=9000){
  if(Date.now() - (sumAt[id]||0) < gap) return; sumAt[id] = Date.now();
  const tok = sportTok;
  try{ const s = await getJSON(`${base}/summary?event=${id}`); if(tok !== sportTok) return; notePlays(id, s); summaryHist.push({t:Date.now(), id, s}); summaryHist = summaryHist.filter(h=>Date.now()-h.t<(Math.max(delay, delayP)+20)*1000);
    // Only redraw for the game on screen or the one on the radio; the rest are just being kept warm.
    if(id===selected || (deck && events.find(x=>x.id===id)?.competitions[0].competitors.some(c=>c.team.location===deck.loc))) render(); }catch(e){}
}
/* ---------- keeping scores and plays in step with the radio ----------
   Radio lag: how many seconds the audio is behind real life. It comes from, in order:
     1. you: "Match radio" -> tap the play the announcer just called; lag = now - when it happened
        (ESPN stamps each play with the real time it happened);
     2. the stream itself: HLS streams that carry clock times (EXT-X-PROGRAM-DATE-TIME);
     3. the − / + buttons, 2 seconds at a time.
   It's remembered per station. Pausing the radio adds the pause (the audio falls further behind).
   ESPN lag: how long after something happens it reaches this page, measured on its own for the
   score feed and for play-by-play (they arrive at different speeds).
   Scores are then held by (radio lag - score lag) and plays by (radio lag - play lag), so the
   score changes and the play shows up as the announcer calls it. */
const espnLag = {}, scoreLag = {}; // game id -> {v, n}: play-by-play lag, score feed lag (seconds)
const seenPlays = new Set(), scoreSeen = {}; // "game|home-away" -> when this page first saw that score
const ema = (o, id, x) => { const L = o[id] || (o[id] = {v: x, n: 0}); L.v = L.n ? L.v*0.7 + x*0.3 : x; L.n++; };
function noteScores(evs){
  const now = Date.now();
  for(const e of evs){ if(e.status?.type?.state!=="in") continue; const c = e.competitions[0];
    const k = `${e.id}|${team(c,"home").score}-${team(c,"away").score}`; if(!scoreSeen[k]) scoreSeen[k] = now; }
}
const playsOf = s => s.drives ? (s.drives?.current?.plays||[]).concat((s.drives?.previous||[]).slice(-1).flatMap(d=>d.plays||[])) : (s.plays||[]).slice(-15);
function notePlays(id, s){
  const plays = playsOf(s);
  if(!notePlays.seen?.has(id)){ // first look at a game: everything in it already happened, so just note what we've seen
    (notePlays.seen || (notePlays.seen = new Set())).add(id);
    plays.forEach(p=>{ if(p.id) seenPlays.add(p.id); });
    return;
  }
  for(const p of plays){
    if(!p.id || seenPlays.has(p.id)) continue; seenPlays.add(p.id);
    const w = Date.parse(p.wallclock||""); if(isNaN(w)) continue;
    const lag = (Date.now() - w)/1000;
    if(lag >= 0 && lag <= 120) ema(espnLag, id, lag);
    // When did the score feed first show this play's score?
    if(p.scoringPlay && p.homeScore != null){ const t0 = scoreSeen[`${id}|${p.homeScore}-${p.awayScore}`];
      if(t0){ const sl = (t0 - w)/1000; if(sl >= 0 && sl <= 120) ema(scoreLag, id, sl); } }
  }
}
function radioLag(){ // from the stream's own clock times, when it has them
  try{
    if(hls && hls.playingDate) return (Date.now() - hls.playingDate.getTime())/1000;
    const sd = audio.getStartDate ? audio.getStartDate() : null;
    if(sd && !isNaN(sd.getTime()) && sd.getTime() > 0) return (Date.now() - sd.getTime())/1000 - audio.currentTime;
  }catch(e){}
  return null;
}
const streamKey = u => { try{ const x = new URL(u); return x.host + x.pathname; }catch(e){ return u; } };
let syncMode = "off", delayP = 0, pauseAdd = 0, matchedAt = 0, connectedAt = 0, liveOnly = false;
const stationSync = () => { if(!deck) return null; try{ return JSON.parse(store.get("rl@" + streamKey(deck.url)) || "null"); }catch(e){ return null; } };
const saveStationSync = (rl, src) => { if(deck) store.set("rl@" + streamKey(deck.url), JSON.stringify({rl: Math.round(rl*10)/10, src, at: Date.now()})); };
function radioLagNow(){
  const st = stationSync();
  if(st && st.src !== "stream") { syncMode = st.src; return st.rl + pauseAdd; }
  const live = radioLag(); if(live != null && live > 0 && live < 180){ syncMode = "stream"; return live; }
  if(st){ syncMode = st.src; return st.rl + pauseAdd; }
  syncMode = "off"; return null;
}
const onAirGame = () => deck && events.find(x=>x.status.type.state==="in" && x.competitions[0].competitors.some(c=>c.team.location===deck.loc));
const lagsFor = g => { const pl = espnLag[g?.id]?.n ? espnLag[g.id].v : 15, sl = scoreLag[g?.id]?.n ? scoreLag[g.id].v : pl; return {pl, sl}; };
function autoSync(){
  if(!deck || audio.paused || connecting) return;
  if(liveOnly){ if(delay || delayP) setDelays(0, 0); else syncLabel(); return; }
  const R = radioLagNow(), g = onAirGame();
  if(R == null || !g){ if(syncMode==="off" && (delay || delayP)) setDelays(0, 0); else syncLabel(); return; }
  const {pl, sl} = lagsFor(g);
  const dS = Math.round(Math.max(0, R - sl)), dP = Math.round(Math.max(0, R - pl));
  if(Math.abs(dS - delay) >= 2 || Math.abs(dP - delayP) >= 2) setDelays(dS, dP); else syncLabel();
}
setInterval(autoSync, 2000);
let syncPausedAt = 0;
function snap(arr, match, d = delay){ // newest snapshot at least `d` seconds old
  const cut = Date.now() - d*1000; let pick = null;
  for(const h of arr){ if(match && !match(h)) continue; if(h.t <= cut) pick = h; }
  if(!pick){ const m = arr.filter(h=>!match||match(h)); pick = m[0]; }
  return pick;
}

/* The list is only rebuilt when something in it changed (scores, status, radio buttons...).
   Rebuilding every few seconds dropped taps and moved VoiceOver; running clocks tick on their own. */
function setList(html){
  const key = html.replace(/(<span data-clk="[^"]*">)[^<]*/g, "$1");
  const list = $("#list");
  if(key === setList.last && list.firstChild) return false;
  setList.last = key; homeBoard(); list.innerHTML = html; return true;
}
// When the game you have open ends, its final stays up (with its details) for 10 minutes.
const lastLiveAt = {};
const justEnded = e => e.status.type.state==="post" && lastLiveAt[e.id] && Date.now() - lastLiveAt[e.id] < 10*60e3;
// Wide screens: with no game to show beside the list (nothing live), the list uses the full width.
function syncLayout(){ document.querySelector(".grid")?.classList.toggle("solo", $("#board").hidden); }
function render(){
  const s = snap(history); events = s ? s.evs : []; events.forEach(e=>{ if(e.status?.type?.state==='in'){ trackClock(e, s.t); lastLiveAt[e.id] = Date.now(); } });
  const order = {in:0, pre:1, post:2};
  const kept = events.filter(e=>e.id===selected && justEnded(e));
  const live = events.filter(e=>e.status.type.state==="in").concat(kept);
  if(!live.length && !history.length){ setList(`<div class="empty">Loading today's games…</div>`); $("#board").hidden = true; syncLayout(); updateDeck(); return; }
  if(!live.length){ renderUpcoming(); syncLayout(); updateDeck(); return; }
  if(!selected || !live.some(e=>e.id===selected)){
    if(selected && NARROW.matches){ boardOpen = false; store.set("openGame", ""); } // the open game ended
    selected = (live.find(isFavGame) || live[0])?.id || null;
  }
  $("#board").hidden = false;
  // Fetch the open game's details right away instead of waiting for the next refresh.
  if(selected && boardOpen && live.some(e=>e.id===selected && e.status.type.state==="in")) pollSummary(selected, 6000);
  const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  renderChips(events.filter(e=>isToday(e.date) || e.status.type.state==="in"), live);
  trackLeads(live);
  updateFeatured(live);
  let shown = live.filter(e=> divOK(e))
    .filter(e=> !q || e.competitions[0].competitors.some(t=>[t.team.location,t.team.displayName,t.team.shortDisplayName,t.team.abbreviation].join(" ").toLowerCase().includes(q)))
    .sort((a,b)=> liveRank(a)-liveRank(b) || new Date(a.date)-new Date(b.date) || a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
  const list = $("#list");
  let changed;
  if(!shown.length){
    const why = q ? `No live games match “${esc(query.trim())}”.` : divFilter==="fav" ? "None of your teams are playing right now. Tap ☆ on a team to add it." : `No ${divFilter==="T25" ? "Top 25" : esc(divFilter.replace(/^c:/,""))} games are live right now.`;
    changed = setList(`<div class="sect big"><span>Live</span></div><div class="empty">${why}</div>` + renderUpcoming(true) + finalsToday());
  } else changed = setList(liveSection(shown, q) + renderUpcoming(true) + finalsToday());
  if(changed) list.querySelectorAll(".card").forEach(b=>{ const go=()=>{
      // Tapping the open game folds its details away; tapping another opens it, keeping that game where it was on screen.
      const id = b.dataset.id, y0 = b.getBoundingClientRect().top;
      // Tapping the open game closes its details (on a computer the list then uses the full width).
      if(id===selected){ boardOpen = !boardOpen; } else { selected = id; boardOpen = true; }
      store.set("openGame", boardOpen ? selected : "");
      if(!NARROW.matches) store.set("boardClosed", boardOpen ? "" : "1");
      render();
      const nb = $(`#list .card[data-id="${CSS.escape(id)}"]`);
      if(nb) window.scrollBy(0, nb.getBoundingClientRect().top - y0);
    }; b.onclick=ev=>{ if(ev.target.closest(".ear,.fav")) return; go(); }; b.onkeydown=ev=>{ if(ev.target!==b) return; if(ev.key==="Enter"||ev.key===" "){ ev.preventDefault(); go(); } }; });
  renderBoard();
  placeBoard();
  syncLayout(); updateDeck();
}
/* Featured games. In order: overtime, close finishes, comebacks, upset watch, ranked vs ranked,
   rivalries, unbeaten teams late in the season, basketball win streaks of 6+. */
const REG = {fb:4, mbb:2, wbb:4, mhk:3, whk:3, bsb:9, sb:7};             // regulation periods / innings
const HALF2 = {fb:3, mbb:2, wbb:3, mhk:2, whk:2, bsb:5, sb:4};          // "second half" for upset watch
const COMEBACK = {fb:[17,8], mbb:[15,4], wbb:[15,4], mhk:[3,1], whk:[3,1], bsb:[5,1], sb:[5,1]}; // [was down, now within]
const scoresOf = e => { const c = e.competitions[0]; return [Number(team(c,"home").score)||0, Number(team(c,"away").score)||0]; };
const rankedT = t => t.curatedRank?.current && t.curatedRank.current < 26;
const overtime = e => (e.status?.period||0) > (REG[SPORT.id] || 99);
// Biggest lead each side has had: watched while the page is open, plus the score at the end of each period.
const LEADS = (()=>{ try{ const o = JSON.parse(store.get("leads")||"{}"), cut = Date.now() - 2*864e5; for(const k in o) if(o[k].t < cut) delete o[k]; return o; }catch(e){ return {}; } })();
function trackLeads(live){
  let dirty = false;
  for(const e of live){
    if(e.status.type.state!=="in") continue;
    const c = e.competitions[0], h = team(c,"home"), a = team(c,"away"), L = LEADS[e.id] || (LEADS[e.id] = {h:0, a:0, t:Date.now()});
    const marks = [scoresOf(e)];
    let hs = 0, as = 0; (h.linescores||[]).forEach((l, i)=>{ hs += +l.value||0; as += +(a.linescores||[])[i]?.value||0; marks.push([hs, as]); });
    for(const [x, y] of marks){ if(x-y > L.h){ L.h = x-y; dirty = true; } if(y-x > L.a){ L.a = y-x; dirty = true; } }
    L.t = Date.now();
  }
  if(dirty) store.set("leads", JSON.stringify(LEADS));
}
function comeback(e){
  const L = LEADS[e.id], cb = COMEBACK[SPORT.id]; if(!L || !cb) return false;
  const [x, y] = scoresOf(e);
  return (L.h >= cb[0] && x - y <= cb[1]) || (L.a >= cb[0] && y - x <= cb[1]);
}
function upset(e){
  if((e.status?.period||0) < (HALF2[SPORT.id] || 99)) return false;
  const c = e.competitions[0], h = team(c,"home"), a = team(c,"away"), [x, y] = scoresOf(e);
  const lead = x > y ? h : y > x ? a : null, trail = lead===h ? a : h;
  return !!lead && !rankedT(lead) && rankedT(trail);
}
const RIVALS = {
  fb: [["Ohio State","Michigan"],["Alabama","Auburn"],["Army","Navy"],["Georgia","Florida"],["Texas","Oklahoma"],["Oregon","Washington"],["USC","UCLA"],["Notre Dame","USC"],["Clemson","South Carolina"],["Florida","Florida State"],["Ole Miss","Mississippi State"],["Texas","Texas A&M"],["Michigan","Michigan State"],["Minnesota","Wisconsin"],["Iowa","Iowa State"],["Kansas","Kansas State"],["Oklahoma","Oklahoma State"],["BYU","Utah"],["Auburn","Georgia"],["Alabama","Tennessee"],["Pittsburgh","West Virginia"],["California","Stanford"],["Oregon","Oregon State"],["Washington","Washington State"],["Arizona","Arizona State"],["Miami","Florida State"],["Virginia","Virginia Tech"],["North Carolina","NC State"],["Louisville","Kentucky"],["Indiana","Purdue"],["Harvard","Yale"],["Lehigh","Lafayette"],["Grambling","Southern"],["Texas Tech","TCU"],["Baylor","TCU"],["Nebraska","Iowa"],["Penn State","Ohio State"],["Colorado","Colorado State"],["Utah","Utah State"]],
  bb: [["Duke","North Carolina"],["Kentucky","Louisville"],["Kansas","Kansas State"],["Kansas","Missouri"],["Indiana","Purdue"],["Michigan","Michigan State"],["Arizona","Arizona State"],["UCLA","USC"],["Syracuse","Georgetown"],["Villanova","Georgetown"],["Gonzaga","Saint Mary's"],["Cincinnati","Xavier"],["Alabama","Auburn"],["Kentucky","Tennessee"],["UConn","Tennessee"],["UConn","South Carolina"],["UConn","Villanova"],["Texas","Oklahoma"],["Ohio State","Michigan"],["Iowa","Iowa State"],["North Carolina","NC State"],["Virginia","Virginia Tech"],["Florida","Florida State"],["Oregon","Oregon State"],["Washington","Washington State"],["BYU","Utah"],["Memphis","Louisville"],["Marquette","Wisconsin"],["Kentucky","Indiana"],["Stanford","California"]],
  hk: [["Minnesota","Wisconsin"],["Michigan","Michigan State"],["North Dakota","Minnesota"],["Denver","Colorado College"],["Boston College","Boston University"],["Harvard","Cornell"],["Minnesota","Minnesota Duluth"],["North Dakota","Denver"],["Michigan","Notre Dame"],["Boston University","Northeastern"]],
  bs: [["Florida","Florida State"],["LSU","Ole Miss"],["Texas","Texas A&M"],["Arkansas","Missouri"],["Stanford","California"],["UCLA","USC"]],
  sb: [["Oklahoma","Texas"],["Florida","Florida State"],["UCLA","Arizona"],["Alabama","Auburn"]],
};
const rivalSet = {}; for(const [k, list] of Object.entries(RIVALS)) rivalSet[k] = new Set(list.map(p=>p.map(normName).sort().join("|")));
const rivalry = e => { const c = e.competitions[0]; const key = [team(c,"home").team, team(c,"away").team].map(t=>normName(t.location || t.shortDisplayName)).sort().join("|");
  return !!rivalSet[isFB() ? "fb" : SPORT.tile]?.has(key); };
// Unbeaten late in the season: basketball from January with 10+ wins, football from October with 6+.
function unbeaten(e){
  const m = new Date().getMonth(), late = isFB() ? (m >= 9 || m === 0) : SPORT.court ? m <= 3 : false, need = isFB() ? 6 : 10;
  return late && e.competitions[0].competitors.some(t=>{ const [w, l, tie] = String(t.records?.[0]?.summary||"").split("-").map(Number); return w >= need && l === 0 && !tie; });
}
const hotStreak = e => e.competitions[0].competitors.some(t=>streakOf(t.team) >= 6);
/* Featured: a points system. A game earns points for what makes it worth tuning in to right now;
   once it's featured it stays until it's final. Up to 4 games are featured at 40+ points; a 5th spot
   opens only for a game worth 60+. When several qualify at once, the highest scores go in first.
     Overtime ............................................ 50
     Close finish (close, late) .......................... 40
     Ranked vs ranked .................................... 30   (+10 if both are top 10)
     Comeback (was way down, now within one score) ....... 30
     Upset watch (unranked leading ranked, 2nd half) ..... 25   (+10 if the ranked team is top 10)
     Rivalry ............................................. 20
     Close in the second half (within one score) ......... 10
     Unbeaten late in the season ......................... 15
     Win streak 6+ (basketball) .......................... 10   (+2 per extra win, up to 25)
     One Top 25 team ...................................... 5   (+5 if top 10) */
const FEAT_IN = 40, FEAT_FIFTH = 60, FEAT_MAX = 5, FEAT_USUAL = 4;
// Points for a game, itemized: [[reason, points], ...].
function featureBreakdown(e){
  const cs = e.competitions[0].competitors, rk = t => (rankedT(t) ? t.curatedRank.current : 99);
  const ranked = cs.filter(rankedT), top10 = cs.filter(t=>rk(t) <= 10), out = [];
  if(overtime(e)) out.push(["Overtime", 50]);
  else if(crunch(e)) out.push(["Close finish", 40]);
  else { const [x, y] = scoresOf(e), cb = COMEBACK[SPORT.id]; if(cb && (e.status?.period||0) >= (HALF2[SPORT.id]||99) && Math.abs(x - y) <= cb[1]) out.push(["Close in the second half", 10]); }
  if(ranked.length === 2) out.push([top10.length === 2 ? "Top 10 vs top 10" : "Ranked vs ranked", 30 + (top10.length === 2 ? 10 : 0)]);
  else if(ranked.length === 1) out.push([top10.length ? "Top 10 team" : "Top 25 team", 5 + (top10.length ? 5 : 0)]);
  if(comeback(e)) out.push(["Comeback", 30]);
  if(upset(e)){ const trail = cs.find(t=>rankedT(t)), big = trail && rk(trail) <= 10; out.push([big ? "Upset watch (top 10 trailing)" : "Upset watch", 25 + (big ? 10 : 0)]); }
  if(rivalry(e)) out.push(["Rivalry", 20]);
  if(unbeaten(e)) out.push(["Unbeaten late in the season", 15]);
  // Longer streaks count more: 6 wins = 10, +2 per extra win, up to 25 (a 14-game streak).
  const st = Math.max(...cs.map(t=>streakOf(t.team))); if(st >= 6) out.push([`${st}-game win streak`, Math.min(25, 10 + 2*(st - 6))]);
  return out;
}
function featureScore(e){ return featureBreakdown(e).reduce((t, [, p])=>t + p, 0); }
// Every pick is recorded, itemized, so it can be reviewed later: an analytics event the daily
// Featured report reads ("featured/<sport>/<game id>"), plus a log on this device.
function logFeatured(e, slot){
  const c = e.competitions[0], a = team(c,"away"), h = team(c,"home"), items = featureBreakdown(e), pts = items.reduce((t, [, p])=>t + p, 0);
  const rk = t => rankedT(t) ? `#${t.curatedRank.current} ` : "";
  const title = `${slot} | ${rk(a)}${a.team.location} ${a.score} at ${rk(h)}${h.team.location} ${h.score} | ${statusText(e).short} | ${pts} pts: ${items.map(([r, p])=>`${r} +${p}`).join(", ")}`;
  track(`featured/${SPORT.id}/${e.id}`, title);
  try{ const log = JSON.parse(store.get("featuredLog")||"[]").filter(x=>Date.now() - x.at < 3*864e5); log.push({at: Date.now(), sport: SPORT.id, id: e.id, title}); store.set("featuredLog", JSON.stringify(log)); }catch(err){}
}
// The featured games for each sport, kept on this device for the day so a refresh doesn't reshuffle them.
const FEAT = (()=>{ try{ const o = JSON.parse(store.get("featured")||"{}"); return o.day === new Date().toDateString() ? o : {day: new Date().toDateString()}; }catch(e){ return {day: new Date().toDateString()}; } })();
// FEAT[sport] = the 4 Featured games; FEAT[sport + "|pick"] = the Editor's Pick (the 5th spot, 60+ points only).
function updateFeatured(live){
  const key = SPORT.id, ids = FEAT[key] || [], pick0 = FEAT[key + "|pick"] || "";
  const byId = new Map(events.map(e=>[e.id, e]));
  const alive = id => { const e = byId.get(id); return !!id && (!e || e.status.type.state !== "post"); }; // a pick leaves only when it's over
  const keep = ids.filter(alive); let pick = alive(pick0) ? pick0 : "";
  const cands = live.filter(e=>e.status.type.state==="in" && !keep.includes(e.id) && e.id !== pick).map(e=>[e, featureScore(e)])
    .filter(([, p])=>p >= FEAT_IN).sort((x, y)=>y[1]-x[1]);
  for(const [e, p] of cands){
    if(keep.length < FEAT_USUAL){ keep.push(e.id); logFeatured(e, "Featured"); }
    else if(!pick && p >= FEAT_FIFTH){ pick = e.id; logFeatured(e, "Editor's Pick"); }
  }
  if(keep.join() !== ids.join() || pick !== pick0){ FEAT[key] = keep; FEAT[key + "|pick"] = pick; FEAT.day = new Date().toDateString(); store.set("featured", JSON.stringify(FEAT)); }
}
// Live games: a few standout games on top (close finishes, ranked matchups), then the rest under
// conference bars you can fold. A filter or a search shows one plain list instead.
function liveSection(shown, q){
  const both = e => e.competitions[0].competitors.every(t=>t.curatedRank?.current && t.curatedRank.current < 26);
  const grouped = !q && divFilter==="all" && shown.length > 4; // Top 25 and Saved are short lists: no conference bars
  // Featured games, in the order they were picked (they stay until they're final).
  const best = grouped ? (FEAT[SPORT.id] || []).map(id=>shown.find(e=>e.id===id)).filter(Boolean) : [];
  const pick = grouped ? shown.find(e=>e.id===FEAT[SPORT.id + "|pick"]) : null;
  const rest = shown.filter(e=>!best.includes(e) && e !== pick);
  const groups = new Map();
  if(grouped) for(const e of rest){ const c = groupConf(e); if(!groups.has(c)) groups.set(c, []); groups.get(c).push(e); }
  const names = [...groups.keys()].sort(byConf);
  const useBars = grouped && !(names.length===1 && names[0]==="Other games");
  // Many conferences live (basketball nights, football Saturdays): the major ones and any with a
  // saved team stay out; the rest fold into one "More conferences" bar.
  const main = names.filter(n => confRank(n) < 1e3 || groups.get(n).some(isFavGame));
  const more = names.filter(n => !main.includes(n));
  const fold = !(names.length <= 6 || more.length < 3);
  const allShut = (fold ? [...main, "More conferences"] : names).every(liveShut);
  // The Editor's Pick (a 5th game worth 60+ points) goes on top, above the Featured games.
  let html = pick ? `<div class="sect big"><span>Editor's Pick</span></div><div class="flat best">${card(pick)}</div>` : "";
  if(best.length) html += `<div class="sect big${pick ? " sub" : ""}"><span>Featured</span></div><div class="flat best">${best.map(e=>card(e)).join("")}</div>`;
  html += `<div class="sect big${best.length ? "" : ""}"><span>Live<span class="sn lv">${best.length || pick ? rest.length+" more" : shown.length}</span></span>${useBars && names.length > 1 ? `<button class="lnk" data-confall="${allShut?"open":"shut"}" data-cday="live">${allShut?"Expand all":"Collapse all"}</button>` : ""}</div>`;
  if(!useBars) return html + `<div class="flat">${rest.map(e=>card(e)).join("")}</div>`;
  const bar = n => { const gs = groups.get(n), shut = liveShut(n); return confHead(n, gs.length, shut, "live") + (shut ? "" : gs.map(e=>card(e)).join("")); };
  if(!fold) return html + names.map(bar).join("");
  const shutMore = liveShut("More conferences");
  return html + main.map(bar).join("") + `<div class="cgap"></div>` + confHead("More conferences", more.reduce((t, n)=>t + groups.get(n).length, 0), shutMore, "live")
    + (shutMore ? "" : `<div class="more-confs">${more.map(bar).join("")}</div>`);
}
// On phones the game details open right under the game you tapped; on wide screens they sit beside the list.
const NARROW = matchMedia("(max-width: 860px)");
const boardHome = (()=>{ const b = document.getElementById("board"); return {parent: b.parentNode, next: b.nextSibling}; })();
// The game details live inside the list on phones; put them back before the list is replaced.

function placeBoard(){
  const B = $("#board"), card = selected && $(`#list .card[data-id="${CSS.escape(selected)}"]`);

  else {

    if(NARROW.matches) B.hidden = true;
  }
}

let currentTeam = null, connecting = null;
const ready = {}; // team -> flat list of direct stream URLs, best first
function ear(loc, label){
  const has = (RADIO[loc]?.streams?.length) || RADIO[loc]?.external || store.get("stream:"+loc);
  const icon = `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 15v-3a8 8 0 0 1 16 0v3"/><rect x="3" y="14" width="5" height="7" rx="2"/><rect x="16" y="14" width="5" height="7" rx="2"/></svg><span class="bars" aria-hidden="true"><i></i><i></i><i></i></span>`;
  const text = label ? `<span>${esc(label)}</span>` : "";
  if(!has && waitsForFeed(loc) && !lateFor(loc)) return `<button class="ear soon" data-off="${esc(loc)}" aria-disabled="true" title="${esc(loc)} radio ${feedText(loc, false)}" aria-label="${esc(loc)} radio ${feedText(loc, false)}">${icon}${text}</button>`;
  if(!has && !label) return `<span class="ear ghost" aria-hidden="true"></span>`; // no dead buttons in the list
  if(!has) return `<button class="ear off" data-off="${esc(loc)}" aria-disabled="true" title="${esc(loc)} radio unavailable" aria-label="${esc(loc)} radio unavailable">${icon}${text}</button>`;
  const on = currentTeam===loc && !audio.paused, wait = connecting===loc;
  return `<button class="ear ${on?"on":""} ${wait?"wait":""}" data-team="${esc(loc)}" title="${on?"Pause":"Listen to"} ${esc(loc)} radio" aria-label="${on?"Pause":"Listen to"} ${esc(loc)} radio">${icon}${text}</button>`;
}
async function prepareTeam(loc){
  if(ready[loc]) return;
  const r = RADIO[loc]; if(!r?.streams) return;
  ready[loc] = [];
  const urls = [];
  // Follow the directory's order (official feeds first, music/blocked streams last) rather than
  // whichever stream happened to work last time, so fixes reach phones right away.
  const saved = store.get("stream:"+loc); if(saved) urls.push(saved);
  for(const c of r.streams){ for(const u of await resolveCandidate(c)) urls.push(u); }
  ready[loc] = [...new Set(urls)];
}
// Tapping a team with no radio explains why instead of doing nothing.
function toast(msg){
  let t = document.getElementById("toast");
  if(!t){ t = document.createElement("div"); t.id = "toast"; t.setAttribute("role","status"); t.onclick = ()=>t.classList.remove("show"); document.body.appendChild(t); }
  // A last line starting with "*" is a footnote, shown smaller.
  const lines = msg.split("\n"), fn = lines.length>1 && lines[lines.length-1].startsWith("*") ? lines.pop() : null;
  t.textContent = lines.join("\n");
  if(fn){ const f = document.createElement("small"); f.className = "fn"; f.textContent = fn; t.appendChild(f); }
  t.classList.add("show");
  clearTimeout(toast._h); toast._h = setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove("show"), Math.min(15000, 3000 + msg.length*40));
}

function listenTo(loc){

}

// Game status text. ESPN's feed resets the clock to 15:00 during the break
// between quarters, so detect breaks from the status name and the last play.
const ORD = ["","1st","2nd","3rd","4th"];
const qName = p => p>4 ? (p===5?"OT":`${p-4}OT`) : ORD[p];
const lastSeen = {}; // game id -> last period seen with the clock running
function lastPlayInfo(e){
  const sum = snap(summaryHist, x=>x.id===e.id, delayP)?.s, d = sum?.drives;
  let play = null;
  const cur = d?.current?.plays; if(cur?.length) play = cur[cur.length-1];
  if(!play){ const prev = d?.previous; const last = prev?.[prev.length-1]?.plays; if(last?.length) play = last[last.length-1]; }
  const text = e.competitions?.[0]?.situation?.lastPlay?.text || play?.text || "";
  return {text, period: play?.period?.number || null};
}
function breakAfter(e){
  // Returns the quarter that just ended if the game is between quarters, else 0.
  const st = e.status, t = st.type, p = st.period||0, name = t.name||"", sd = t.shortDetail||"";
  if(name==="STATUS_HALFTIME" || /halftime/i.test(sd)) return 2;
  if(name==="STATUS_END_PERIOD" || /^end of/i.test(sd) || (st.displayClock==="0:00" && p<=4)){
    const m = sd.match(/(1st|2nd|3rd|4th)/); return m ? ({"1st":1,"2nd":2,"3rd":3,"4th":4})[m[1]] : p;
  }
  if(st.displayClock!=="15:00" || p<=1) return 0;
  // Clock reset to 15:00: a break unless a play has already happened this quarter.
  const lp = lastPlayInfo(e);
  if(lp.period) return lp.period < p ? lp.period : 0;
  const txt = lp.text.match(/end of (?:the )?(1st|2nd|3rd|4th|first|second|third|fourth|half|1st half)/i);
  if(txt){ const w = txt[1].toLowerCase(); return ({"1st":1,first:1,"2nd":2,second:2,half:2,"1st half":2,"3rd":3,third:3,"4th":4,fourth:4})[w] || p-1; }
  if(lastSeen[e.id] && lastSeen[e.id] < p) return lastSeen[e.id];
  return 0;
}
// Running clock: the feed sends a new reading every few seconds; between
// readings, count down locally when the last two readings show the clock moving.
const clk = {};
const toSec = c => { const m = /^(\d+):(\d\d)$/.exec(c||""); return m ? (+m[1])*60 + (+m[2]) : null; };
const fmtSec = n => `${Math.floor(n/60)}:${String(n%60).padStart(2,"0")}`;
function trackClock(e, t){
  const st = e.status, raw = `${st.period}|${st.displayClock}`, sec = toSec(st.displayClock);
  const prev = clk[e.id];
  if(prev && prev.raw === raw){
    // A newer reading that hasn't moved means the clock is stopped.
    // The feed can repeat a reading for a few polls, so wait 12s before calling it stopped.
    if(prev.running && Date.now() - prev.at > 12000){ prev.shown = prev.sec; prev.running = false; } // the feed reports a stoppage with the clock's real value, so show that
    return;
  }
  const real = prev ? Math.max(1, (t - prev.t)/1000) : 0;
  const running = !!(prev && sec!=null && prev.period===st.period && sec < prev.sec && (prev.sec - sec) >= 0.5*real && st.type.state==="in");
  clk[e.id] = {raw, sec, period:st.period, at:Date.now(), t, running};
}
function liveClock(e){
  const c = clk[e.id]; if(!c || c.sec==null) return e.status.displayClock;
  if(!c.running) return fmtSec(c.shown ?? c.sec);
  const gone = Math.min(12, Math.floor((Date.now()-c.at)/1000)); // never run more than 12s past the last reading
  return fmtSec(Math.max(0, c.sec - gone));
}
setInterval(()=>{ document.querySelectorAll("[data-clk]").forEach(el=>{ const e = events.find(x=>x.id===el.dataset.clk); if(e) el.textContent = liveClock(e); }); }, 1000);
function statusText(e){
  const st = e.status, t = st.type, p = st.period||0;
  if(t.state!=="in") return {short:t.shortDetail, long:t.shortDetail, brk:false};
  if(!isFB()){
    // ESPN sends "4:12 - 2nd Half" / "12:30 - 2nd" / "Top 5th" / "3rd Set". Clocked sports get a ticking clock.
    // (under a minute ESPN sends "45.2 - 2nd Half")
    const m = /^(\d+:\d\d|\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*-\s*(.+)$/.exec(t.shortDetail||""), md = /^(\d+:\d\d|\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*-\s*(.+)$/.exec(t.detail||"");
    if(SPORT.clock && m) return {short:`${esc(m[2])} <span data-clk="${e.id}">${liveClock(e)}</span>`, long: md ? md[2] : m[2], brk:false, per:m[2]};
    return {short:esc(t.shortDetail||""), long:t.detail||t.shortDetail||"", brk: !m && /half|end|intermission|break/i.test(t.shortDetail||""), per:""};
  }
  const q = breakAfter(e);
  if(q){
    const lab = q===2 ? "Halftime" : (q===4 && p<=4 ? "End of regulation" : `End of ${qName(q)}`);
    return {short:lab, long:lab, brk:true};
  }
  if(st.displayClock!=="15:00") lastSeen[e.id] = p;
  return {short:`${qName(p)} <span data-clk="${e.id}">${liveClock(e)}</span>`, long:p>4?qName(p):`${qName(p)} Qtr`, brk:false};
}
// Radio bar: while a team's radio is on, show its game's score and situation.
let deck = null;
function gameLine(loc){
  const e = events.find(x=>x.status.type.state==="in" && x.competitions[0].competitors.some(c=>c.team.location===loc));
  if(!e) return null;
  const c = e.competitions[0], a = team(c,"away"), h = team(c,"home"), sit = c.situation || {}, stx = statusText(e);
  const ab = t => esc(t.team.abbreviation || t.team.shortDisplayName);
  const score = `<b class="dsc">${ab(a)} ${esc(a.score)} · ${ab(h)} ${esc(h.score)}</b>`;
  if(!isFB()){
    const parts = [score, stx.short];
    if(SPORT.sets){ const s = setPoints(e); if(s) parts.push(`Set ${s.n}: ${s.a}–${s.h}`); }
    if(SPORT.diamond && sit.outs!=null) parts.push(`${sit.outs} out${sit.outs==1?"":"s"}`);
    if(SPORT.tile==="bb" && !stx.brk){ const pid = possId(e), pos = [a,h].find(t=>t.team.id===pid); if(pos) parts.push(`${ab(pos)} ball`); }
    return parts.join('<span class="dsep"></span>');
  }
  const clock = stx.brk ? esc(stx.short) : `<span data-clk="${e.id}">${liveClock(e)}</span> ${esc(qName(e.status.period))}`;
  const pid = possId(e), pos = [a,h].find(t=>t.team.id===pid);
  const parts = [score, clock];
  if(!stx.brk){
    if(pos) parts.push(`${ab(pos)} ball`);
    if(goodDD(sit.downDistanceText)) parts.push(esc(sit.downDistanceText));
    else if(sit.possessionText) parts.push(`at ${esc(sit.possessionText)}`);
    if(sit.isRedZone) parts.push(`<span class="drz">Red zone</span>`);
  }
  const lv = deck && liveVerdict(deck.url), hv = deck && heard(deck.url);
  if((lv?.verdict==="music" && hv!=="game") || hv==="not_game") parts.push(`<span class="dwarn">Station may not be carrying the game</span>`);
  return parts.join('<span class="dsep"></span>');
}
function setIdle(){ document.querySelector(".deck").classList.toggle("idle", !currentTeam); }
function updateDeck(){
  setIdle();
  if(!deck || connecting) return;
  const line = gameLine(deck.loc);
  if(line) $("#nowSub").innerHTML = line; else $("#nowSub").textContent = deck.sub;
  updateLockScreen();
}
// Lock screen / Control Center "Now Playing" card (Media Session API).
let lastMeta = "";
function updateLockScreen(){
  if(!("mediaSession" in navigator) || !deck) return;
  const e = events.find(x=>x.status.type.state==="in" && x.competitions[0].competitors.some(c=>c.team.location===deck.loc));
  const net = (RADIO[deck.loc]?.net) || `${deck.loc} radio`;
  let title = `${deck.loc} radio`, artist = net, logo = "";
  if(e){
    const c = e.competitions[0], a = team(c,"away"), h = team(c,"home"), sit = c.situation||{}, stx = statusText(e);
    const ab = t => t.team.abbreviation || t.team.shortDisplayName;
    const pid = possId(e), pos = [a,h].find(t=>t.team.id===pid);
    title = `${ab(a)} ${a.score}  ·  ${ab(h)} ${h.score}`;
    const bits = !isFB() ? [stx.per ? `${stx.per} ${liveClock(e)}` : (e.status.type.shortDetail||"")] : [stx.brk ? stx.short : `${qName(e.status.period)} ${liveClock(e)}`];
    if(!stx.brk){
      if(goodDD(sit.downDistanceText)) bits.push(sit.downDistanceText);
      if(pos) bits.push(`${ab(pos)} ball`);
    }
    artist = bits.join("  ·  ");
    // Artwork shows whoever has the ball; between possessions, the team you're listening to.
    logo = (!stx.brk && pos?.team.logo) || (c.competitors.find(x=>x.team.location===deck.loc)?.team.logo) || "";
  }
  const key = title + artist + net + logo;
  if(key === lastMeta) return; lastMeta = key;
  try{
    navigator.mediaSession.metadata = new MediaMetadata({ title, artist, album: net,
      artwork: logo ? [96,192,512].map(n=>({src: logo, sizes: `${n}x${n}`, type: "image/png"})) : [] });
  }catch(err){}
}
// Lock screen buttons: play/pause, and the skip buttons switch between the two teams' broadcasts.
