  if(!("mediaSession" in navigator)) return;
  const ms = navigator.mediaSession, set = (a,f)=>{ try{ ms.setActionHandler(a,f); }catch(e){} };
  set("play", ()=>resumeRadio()); set("pause", ()=>audio.pause());
  set("seekbackward", null); set("seekforward", null); set("seekto", null);
  const other = ()=>{ if(!deck) return;
    const e = events.find(x=>x.status.type.state==="in" && x.competitions[0].competitors.some(c=>c.team.location===deck.loc));
    const o = e?.competitions[0].competitors.find(c=>c.team.location!==deck.loc)?.team.location;
    if(o && (RADIO[o] || store.get("stream:"+o))) listenTo(o); };
  set("nexttrack", other); set("previoustrack", other);
})();
function team(c, side){return c.competitors.find(t=>t.homeAway===side)}
// The game you're listening to gets the same outline as the open game, whichever team's radio it is.
const onAir = e => !!currentTeam && e.competitions[0].competitors.some(t=>t.team.location===currentTeam);
function syncOnAir(){ for(const c of document.querySelectorAll("#list .card")){ const e = events.find(x=>x.id===c.dataset.id); c.classList.toggle("onair", !!e && onAir(e)); } }
function card(e, why){
  const c = e.competitions[0], a = team(c,"away"), h = team(c,"home"), st = e.status.type;
  const showScore = st.state!=="pre";
  // Live win probability (ESPN's model, on the scoreboard for football and basketball), shown like upcoming games' odds.
  const prob = st.state==="in" ? c.situation?.lastPlay?.probability : null, hw = prob?.homeWinPercentage;
  const pctOf = t => { if(hw==null) return ""; const v = hw*100; const hv = v < 1 ? 0 : v > 99 ? 100 : Math.round(v), x = t.homeAway==="home" ? hv : 100 - hv;
    return x === 0 ? "<1%" : x === 100 ? ">99%" : x + "%"; };
  const row = t => `<div class="row"><span class="tm"><button class="fav ${favs.has(t.team.location)?"on":""}" data-fav="${esc(t.team.location)}" aria-label="${favs.has(t.team.location)?"Remove":"Add"} ${esc(t.team.location)} ${favs.has(t.team.location)?"from":"to"} saved teams">${favs.has(t.team.location)?'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m12 3.5 2.6 5.3 5.9.9-4.3 4.1 1 5.8L12 16.9l-5.2 2.7 1-5.8-4.3-4.1 5.9-.9z"/></svg>':'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m12 3.5 2.6 5.3 5.9.9-4.3 4.1 1 5.8L12 16.9l-5.2 2.7 1-5.8-4.3-4.1 5.9-.9z"/></svg>'}</button>${logoImg(t.team)}<span>${t.curatedRank?.current<26?`<small>${t.curatedRank.current}</small> `:""}${esc(nameOf(t.team))}</span></span><span class="right">${hw!=null?`<span class="lpct">${pctOf(t)}</span>`:""}${ear(t.team.location, "")}<span class="sc">${showScore?t.score:""}</span></span></div>`;
  return `<div class="card${onAir(e)?" onair":""}" role="button" tabindex="0" data-id="${e.id}" aria-current="${e.id===selected && boardOpen}" aria-expanded="${e.id===selected && boardOpen}">${row(a)}${row(h)}${hw!=null ? (([ca, ch])=>`<div class="wpbar" aria-label="Win probability: ${esc(a.team.abbreviation)} ${pctOf(a)}, ${esc(h.team.abbreviation)} ${pctOf(h)}"><span style="width:${((1-hw)*100).toFixed(1)}%;background:${ca}"></span><span style="width:${(hw*100).toFixed(1)}%;background:${ch}"></span></div>`)(barColors(a, h)) : ""}
  <div class="meta"><span class="${st.state==="in"?"live":""}">${st.state==="pre"?fmtTime(e.date):statusText(e).short}</span><span>${why ? `<span class="why">${esc(why)}</span>` : ""}${esc((c.broadcasts||[]).flatMap(b=>b.names).join(", "))}<span class="div">${e._div||""}</span><svg class="gchev" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></span></div>${soonNote(e)}</div>`;
}

// ---------- Today's upcoming games (shown when nothing is live) ----------
const POWER = {fb: ["SEC","Big Ten","Big 12","ACC"], bb: ["SEC","Big Ten","Big 12","ACC","Big East"], hk: ["Big Ten","Hockey East","NCHC"]};
const isToday = d => new Date(d).toDateString() === new Date().toDateString();
const CONF_SHORT = {"Metro Atlantic Athletic":"MAAC","Metro Conference (formerly MAAC)":"MAAC","Metro (formerly MAAC)":"MAAC","Mid-American":"MAC","Atlantic Coast":"ACC","Southeastern":"SEC","Mid-Eastern Athletic":"MEAC","Southwestern Athletic":"SWAC","Western Athletic":"WAC","Colonial Athletic Association":"Coastal Athletic Association","National Collegiate Hockey":"NCHC","Central Collegiate Hockey Association":"CCHA","Eastern College Athletic":"ECAC Hockey","East Coast Athletic":"ECAC Hockey"};
const confName = c => { const n = String(c||"").replace(/\s+Conference$/,"").trim(); return CONF_SHORT[n] || n; };
function confOf(tm){
  if(!isFB()){ const c = confMaps[SPORT.id]?.get(String(tm.id)); if(c) return c; if(SPORT.tile==="hk") return ""; }
  for(const n of [tm.location, tm.displayName, `${tm.location} ${tm.name||""}`, tm.shortDisplayName, tm.abbreviation]){
    const hit = dirIndex.get(normName(n));
    // Football-only leagues (Pioneer, MVFC, ...) don't apply to other sports.
    if(hit?.conference && !isFB() && /football|pioneer|independent|united athletic/i.test(hit.conference)) return "";
    if(hit?.conference) return confName(hit.conference);
  }
  return "";
}
const predCache = {}; // game id -> {home, away, at}
const predLoading = new Set(); // games whose odds are being fetched right now (so each is asked for once)
async function loadPredictions(games){
  if(document.hidden) return;
  const todo = games.filter(e=>!predLoading.has(e.id) && (!predCache[e.id] || Date.now()-predCache[e.id].at > 10*60e3)).slice(0, 120);
  todo.forEach(e=>predLoading.add(e.id));
  let i = 0;
  const worker = async ()=>{ while(i < todo.length){ const e = todo[i++];
    try{
      const s = await getJSON(`${base}/summary?event=${e.id}`);
      const h = parseFloat(s.predictor?.homeTeam?.gameProjection), a = parseFloat(s.predictor?.awayTeam?.gameProjection);
      // Every sportsbook ESPN lists for the game (DraftKings, ESPN BET, ...), as home-win chances.
      const books = (s.pickcenter||[]).map(pc=>({name: pc.provider?.name||"Book", p: lineProb(pc), home: Number(pc.homeTeamOdds?.moneyLine)||null, away: Number(pc.awayTeamOdds?.moneyLine)||null, spread: pc.spread})).filter(b=>b.p!=null);
      predCache[e.id] = {home: isNaN(h)?null:h, away: isNaN(a)?null:a, books, at: Date.now()};
    }catch(err){ predCache[e.id] = {home:null, away:null, books:[], at: Date.now()}; }
    predLoading.delete(e.id);
  } };
  await Promise.all([1,2,3,4].map(worker));
  if(todo.length) render();
}
function moneyProb(ml){ ml = Number(ml); if(!ml) return null; return ml < 0 ? -ml/(-ml+100) : 100/(ml+100); }
// Home team's chance from one betting line: the moneyline with the bookmaker's cut removed,
// else the point spread (about a 14-point standard deviation in college football).
function lineProb(o){
  if(!o) return null;
  const h = moneyProb(o.homeTeamOdds?.moneyLine), a = moneyProb(o.awayTeamOdds?.moneyLine);
  if(h && a) return 100*h/(h+a);
  const sp = Number(o.spread);
  // Run lines and puck lines (±1.5) say little about who wins, so only football and basketball use spreads.
  if(SPORT.sigma && o.spread!=null && o.spread!=="" && !isNaN(sp)){ const z = -sp/SPORT.sigma; return 100/(1+Math.exp(-1.7*z)); }
  return null;
}
// Our own number: the average of ESPN's FPI model and the betting market (all listed
// sportsbooks averaged into one market figure), so neither a single book nor one model dominates.
// Only the big, regulated US sportsbooks count toward the betting side.
const MAJOR_BOOKS = /draftkings|fanduel|betmgm|caesars|espn ?bet|thescore|fanatics|betrivers|bet365|hard rock/i;
function winProb(e){
  const p = predCache[e.id] || {};
  const c = e.competitions[0], a = team(c,"away"), h = team(c,"home");
  // Every major book we have a line from: The Odds API first, then any extra ones ESPN lists.
  const og = oddsFor(e), byName = new Map();
  for(const b of og?.books||[]){ const q = lineProb({homeTeamOdds:{moneyLine:b.home}, awayTeamOdds:{moneyLine:b.away}}); if(q!=null) byName.set(b.name.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,""), {...b, p:q}); }
  for(const b of p.books||[]){ const k = b.name.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,""); if(!byName.has(k)) byName.set(k, b); }
  let books = [...byName.values()].filter(b=>MAJOR_BOOKS.test(b.name));
  const o0 = c.odds?.[0], sb = lineProb(o0);
  if(!books.length && sb!=null) books = [{name: o0.provider?.name || "Sportsbook", p: sb, home: Number(o0.homeTeamOdds?.moneyLine)||null, away: Number(o0.awayTeamOdds?.moneyLine)||null, spread: o0.spread}];
  const market = books.length ? books.reduce((x,b)=>x+b.p,0)/books.length : null;
  // ESPN's model shows exactly 100% / 0% when it has no rating for one side (a non-Division I opponent); that isn't a forecast.
  const fpi = p.home!=null && p.home>0 && p.home<100 ? p.home : null;
  const vals = [fpi, market].filter(v=>v!=null);
  if(!vals.length) return null;
  const home = vals.reduce((x,y)=>x+y,0)/vals.length;
  const favH = home>=50, fav = favH ? h : a;
  const short = t => t.team.abbreviation || t.team.shortDisplayName;
  const pct = v => Math.round(favH ? v : 100-v);
  const ml = v => v==null ? "" : (v>0?"+":"")+v;
  const bookLine = b => {
    const m = favH ? b.home : b.away;
    const line = m!=null ? `${short(fav)} ${ml(m)}` : (b.spread!=null && b.spread!=="" ? `spread ${b.spread}` : "line");
    return `   ${b.name}: ${line} → ${pct(b.p)}%`;
  };
  const out = [`${short(fav)} ${pct(home)}% to win`];
  if(fpi!=null && market!=null) out.push(`Average of ESPN's model and the betting odds:`);
  if(fpi!=null) out.push(`• ${SPORT.model || "ESPN model"}: ${pct(fpi)}%`);
  if(market!=null){
    out.push(`• Betting odds: ${pct(market)}%${books.length>1 ? ` (average of ${books.length} sportsbooks)` : ""}`);
    books.forEach(b=>out.push(bookLine(b)));
    out.push(`*Odds are converted to win chances with the bookmaker's cut removed.`);
  }
  return {home, src: fpi!=null && market!=null ? "Consensus" : (fpi!=null ? (SPORT.model||"ESPN model").replace(/ model$/,"") : "Betting odds"), detail: out.join("\n")};
}
function upCard(e){
  const c = e.competitions[0], a = team(c,"away"), h = team(c,"home"), wp = winProb(e), o = c.odds?.[0];
  const hp = wp ? Math.round(wp.home) : null, ap = hp==null ? null : 100-hp;
  const rank = t => t.curatedRank?.current && t.curatedRank.current < 26 ? `<span class="rk">${t.curatedRank.current}</span>` : "";
  const row = (t, pct, isHome) => `<div class="tr"><button class="fav ${favs.has(t.team.location)?"on":""}" data-fav="${esc(t.team.location)}" aria-label="${favs.has(t.team.location)?"Remove":"Add"} ${esc(t.team.location)} ${favs.has(t.team.location)?"from":"to"} saved teams">${favs.has(t.team.location)?'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m12 3.5 2.6 5.3 5.9.9-4.3 4.1 1 5.8L12 16.9l-5.2 2.7 1-5.8-4.3-4.1 5.9-.9z"/></svg>':'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m12 3.5 2.6 5.3 5.9.9-4.3 4.1 1 5.8L12 16.9l-5.2 2.7 1-5.8-4.3-4.1 5.9-.9z"/></svg>'}</button>
    ${logoImg(t.team)}<span class="nm">${isHome?'<span class="at">@ </span>':""}${rank(t)}${esc(nameOf(t.team))}</span>
    <span class="rec">${esc(t.records?.[0]?.summary||"")}</span>${ear(t.team.location, "")}<span class="pct ${pct!=null&&pct>=50?"lead":""}">${pct==null?"":pct+"%"}</span></div>`;
  const sameDay = new Date(e.date).toDateString()===new Date().toDateString() || (!query.trim() && new Date(e.date).toDateString()===upDay);
  const bits = [`<b>${sameDay ? "" : new Date(e.date).toLocaleDateString([], {weekday:"short"})+" "}${new Date(e.date).toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:"numeric", minute:"2-digit", hour12:true})}</b>`];
  const tvs = (c.broadcasts||[]).flatMap(b=>b.names), tv = tvs.slice(0,2).join(", ") + (tvs.length>2?` +${tvs.length-2}`:""); if(tvs.length) bits.push(esc(tv));
  if(o?.details) bits.push(esc(o.details)); if(o?.overUnder) bits.push(`O/U ${esc(o.overUnder)}`);
  return `<div class="up">${row(a, ap, false)}${row(h, hp, true)}
    ${hp!=null?(([ca,ch])=>`<div class="wpbar" aria-label="Win probability: ${esc(a.team.abbreviation)} ${ap}%, ${esc(h.team.abbreviation)} ${hp}%"><span style="width:${ap}%;background:${ca}"></span><span style="width:${hp}%;background:${ch}"></span></div>`)(barColors(a,h)):""}
    <div class="meta"><span class="bits">${bits.map(b=>`<span>${b}</span>`).join("")}</span>${wp?.detail?`<button class="src" data-wp="${esc(wp.detail)}">${esc(wp.src)}</button>`:`<span class="src">${wp?esc(wp.src):(!a.team.logo||!h.team.logo)?"Non-D1 opponent":"No odds yet"}</span>`}</div>${soonNote(e)}</div>`;
}
function finCard(e){
  const c = e.competitions[0], a = team(c,"away"), h = team(c,"home");
  const win = t => Number(t.score) > Number((t===a?h:a).score);
  const row = (t, home) => `<div class="tr ${win(t)?"win":""}">${logoImg(t.team)}<span>${home?'<span class="at">@ </span>':""}${esc(nameOf(t.team))}</span><span class="rec">${esc(t.records?.[0]?.summary||"")}</span><span class="sc">${esc(t.score)}</span></div>`;
  return `<div class="fin">${row(a,false)}${row(h,true)}<div class="meta">${/^final$/i.test(e.status.type.shortDetail||"Final") ? "" : esc(e.status.type.shortDetail)}</div></div>`;
}
function finalsToday(){
  const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  const fin = events.filter(e=>e.status.type.state==="post" && isToday(e.date))
    .filter(e=> divOK(e))
    .filter(e=> !q || e.competitions[0].competitors.some(t=>[t.team.location,t.team.displayName,t.team.shortDisplayName,t.team.abbreviation].join(" ").toLowerCase().includes(q)))
    .sort((x,y)=>new Date(y.date)-new Date(x.date));
  const closed = !q && isShut("Final", "");
  return fin.length ? `<div class="sect big"><span>Final<span class="sn">${fin.length}</span></span><button class="lnk" data-conf="Final" data-cday="">${closed ? "Show" : "Hide"}</button></div>` + (closed ? "" : `<div class="flat">${fin.map(finCard).join("")}</div>`) : "";
}
// Conference headers fold their games away; which ones are folded is remembered on this device.
function confHead(name, n, closed, day){
  return `<button class="conf" data-conf="${esc(name)}" data-cday="${esc(day||"")}" aria-expanded="${!closed}"><span>${esc(name)}</span><span class="cn">${n}</span><svg class="chev" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button>`;
}
document.addEventListener("click", ev=>{
  const b = ev.target.closest("[data-conf],[data-confall]"); if(!b) return;
  if(b.dataset.conf){ const k = confKey(b.dataset.conf, b.dataset.cday); confOpen.has(k) ? confOpen.delete(k) : confOpen.add(k); }
  else { const names = [...document.querySelectorAll("#list [data-conf]")].map(x=>x.dataset.conf).filter(n=>n!=="Final");
    const day = b.dataset.cday;
    if(day==="live"){ [...document.querySelectorAll('#list [data-conf][data-cday="live"]')].forEach(x=>setLiveShut(x.dataset.conf, b.dataset.confall==="shut")); saveConf(); render(); return; }
    [...document.querySelectorAll(`#list [data-conf][data-cday="${CSS.escape(day)}"]`)].map(x=>x.dataset.conf)
      .forEach(n=> b.dataset.confall==="shut" ? confOpen.delete(confKey(n, day)) : confOpen.add(confKey(n, day))); void names; }
  saveConf(); render();
});
let upDay = "";
document.addEventListener("click", ev=>{ const t = ev.target.closest(".daytab[data-day]"); if(!t) return; upDay = upDay===t.dataset.day ? "all" : t.dataset.day; render(); });
// embed: called from render() while games are live; returns the upcoming section to show below them.
function renderUpcoming(embed){
  const list = $("#list"), q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  // The list is redrawn every few seconds; keep the day tabs scrolled where you left them.
  const tabX = list.querySelector(".daytabs")?.scrollLeft;
  queueMicrotask(()=>{ const dt = list.querySelector(".daytabs"); if(dt && tabX!=null) dt.scrollLeft = tabX; });
  // Upcoming games are organized by day: a row of day tabs (Today, Tue 3, Sat 7, ...), each with its
  // games grouped by conference. Opens on today, or the next day with games.
  const pre = events.filter(e=>e.status.type.state==="pre" && new Date(e.date) - Date.now() < 8*864e5);
  const dayKey = d => new Date(d).toDateString();
  const days = [...new Set(pre.sort((a,b)=>new Date(a.date)-new Date(b.date)).map(e=>dayKey(e.date)))];
  if(upDay!=="all" && !days.includes(upDay)){ const r = divFilter==="T25" && !q ? upcomingTop25() : [];
    upDay = r.length ? dayKey(r[0].date) : days[0] || ""; } // with Top 25 on, open on the first day that has ranked games
  // upDay "all" (tap the selected day again) shows every day in the next week, one section per day.
  const viewDays = upDay==="all" ? days : [upDay];
  const today = pre.filter(e=>viewDays.includes(dayKey(e.date)));
  const dayName = k => { const d = new Date(k), t = new Date(); const tm = new Date(Date.now()+864e5);
    return d.toDateString()===t.toDateString() ? "Today" : d.toDateString()===tm.toDateString() ? "Tomorrow" : d.toLocaleDateString([], {weekday:"short", month:"short", day:"numeric"}); };
  const tabs = days.length > 1 ? `<div class="daytabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Pick a day (tap it again to see the whole week)">${days.map(k=>`<button class="daytab" role="tab" data-day="${esc(k)}" aria-selected="${k===upDay}">${esc(dayName(k))}<span class="n">${pre.filter(e=>dayKey(e.date)===k).length}</span></button>`).join("")}</div>` : "";
  const count = f => today.filter(f).length;
  if(!embed) renderChips(today.concat(events.filter(e=>e.status.type.state==="post" && isToday(e.date))), []);
  // Searching for a team looks across the whole week, not just the selected day.
  const shown = (q ? pre : today).filter(e=> divOK(e))
    .filter(e=> !q || e.competitions[0].competitors.some(t=>[t.team.location,t.team.displayName,t.team.shortDisplayName,t.team.abbreviation].join(" ").toLowerCase().includes(q)));
  if(!embed) $("#board").hidden = true;
  if(!shown.length){
    if(embed) return "";
    setList(`<div class="sect big"><span>Up next</span></div>` + (q ? "" : tabs) + `<div class="empty">${q ? `No upcoming games this week match “${esc(query.trim())}”.` : today.length ? (divFilter==="T25" ? "No Top 25 games that day." : "No games that day match that filter.") : "No games scheduled in the next week."}</div>` + finalsToday());
    return;
  }
  const vis = []; // games in open conference bars (other sports only look up odds for these)
  shown.forEach(e=>e.competitions[0].competitors.forEach(c=>{ attachRadio(c.team); prepareTeam(c.team.location); }));
  // One section per day (just one unless the whole week is showing), conferences A-Z inside each.
  const sections = (q ? [...new Set(shown.map(e=>dayKey(e.date)))] : viewDays).map(day=>{
    const dayGames = shown.filter(e=>dayKey(e.date)===day); if(!dayGames.length) return "";
    const groups = new Map();
    for(const e of dayGames){
      const c = e.competitions[0], h = team(c,"home"), a = team(c,"away");
      const conf = confOf(h.team) || confOf(a.team) || (e._div==="FCS" ? "FCS" : isFB() ? "Other" : "Other games");
      if(!groups.has(conf)) groups.set(conf, []); groups.get(conf).push(e);
    }
    // The major conferences first (their own group), then the rest A-Z, then games with no conference.
    const power = n => POWER[isFB() ? "fb" : SPORT.tile]?.indexOf(n) ?? -1;
    const rankC = n => n==="Other games" || n==="Other" ? 2e3 : power(n) >= 0 ? power(n) : 1e3;
    const names = [...groups.keys()].sort((x,y)=>rankC(x)-rankC(y) || x.localeCompare(y));
    // No conference info at all (some hockey days), or a short filtered list (Top 25, Saved): just the games by time, no bars.
    if((names.length===1 && names[0]==="Other games") || ["T25","fav"].includes(divFilter)){
      const gs = dayGames.slice().sort((x,y)=>new Date(x.date)-new Date(y.date) || x.id.localeCompare(y.id)); vis.push(...gs);
      const label = dayName(day)==="Today" ? "Later today" : new Date(day).toLocaleDateString([], {weekday:"long", month:"short", day:"numeric"});
      return `<div class="sect">${esc(label)}</div><div class="flat">${gs.map(upCard).join("")}</div>`;
    }
    const allShut = names.every(n=>isShut(n, day));
    const label = dayName(day)==="Today" ? "Later today" : new Date(day).toLocaleDateString([], {weekday:"long", month:"short", day:"numeric"});
    const bar = (n, i, list) => {
      const gs = groups.get(n), closed = !q && isShut(n, day);
      if(!closed) vis.push(...gs);
      const gap = i > 0 && rankC(list[i-1]) < 1e3 && rankC(n) >= 1e3 ? `<div class="cgap"></div>` : "";
      return gap + confHead(n, gs.length, closed, day) + (closed ? "" : gs.sort((x,y)=>new Date(x.date)-new Date(y.date) || x.id.localeCompare(y.id)).map(upCard).join(""));
    };
    // Big basketball days list 30+ conferences: show the major ones (and any with a saved team),
    // and fold the rest into one "More conferences" bar.
    const main = names.filter(n => rankC(n) < 1e3 || groups.get(n).some(isFavGame));
    const rest = names.filter(n => !main.includes(n));
    const fold = !q && !isFB() && rest.length > 6;
    const head = `<div class="sect">${esc(label)}${names.length>1 && !q ? `<button class="lnk" data-confall="${allShut?"open":"shut"}" data-cday="${esc(day)}">${allShut?"Expand all":"Collapse all"}</button>` : ""}</div>`;
    if(!fold) return head + names.map((n, i)=>bar(n, i, names)).join("");
    const moreShut = isShut("More conferences", day);
    return head + main.map((n, i)=>bar(n, i, main)).join("") + `<div class="cgap"></div>` +
      confHead("More conferences", rest.reduce((t, n)=>t + groups.get(n).length, 0), moreShut, day) +
      (moreShut ? "" : `<div class="more-confs">${rest.map((n, i)=>bar(n, i, rest)).join("")}</div>`);
  }).join("");
  const head = `<div class="sect big"><span>Up next<span class="sn">${shown.length}</span></span></div>`;
  if(embed){ loadPredictions(isFB() ? shown : vis.slice(0, 40)); return head + (q ? "" : tabs) + sections; }
  setList(head + (q ? "" : tabs) + sections + finalsToday());
  // Football looks up every game's odds; a basketball night has far more games, so only the ones you've opened.
  loadPredictions(isFB() ? shown : vis.slice(0, 40));
}

function renderBoard(){
  const e = events.find(x=>x.id===selected); const B = $("#board");
  if(!e || !boardOpen){B.innerHTML = ""; renderBoard.last = ""; B.hidden = true; return;}
  B.hidden = false;
  const c = e.competitions[0], a = team(c,"away"), h = team(c,"home"), st = e.status, sit0 = c.situation||{};
  const ss = snap(summaryHist, x=>x.id===selected, delayP); const sum = ss?.s; const pid = possId(e);
  // During timeouts and reviews the scoreboard drops down-and-distance and the spot;
  // the play-by-play still has them, so fill the gaps from the latest play.
  const lastP = (sum?.drives?.current?.plays||[]).slice(-1)[0];
  const sit = {...sit0};
  if(!sit.downDistanceText && st.type.state==="in") sit.downDistanceText = lastP?.end?.downDistanceText || lastP?.start?.downDistanceText || "";
  if(!sit.possessionText && st.type.state==="in") sit.possessionText = lastP?.end?.possessionText || lastP?.start?.possessionText || "";
  const side = (t, cls) => {
    const tos = cls==="home"?sit.homeTimeouts:sit.awayTimeouts;
    return `<div class="side ${pid===t.team.id?(isFB()?"poss":"poss hoops"):""}">${logoImg(t.team)}
    <div class="nm">${t.team.location}</div><div class="rec">${t.records?.[0]?.summary||""}${cls==="home"?" · Home":""}</div>
    <div class="big">${st.type.state==="pre"?"–":t.score}</div>${ear(t.team.location, "Listen")}
    ${tos!=null?`<div class="to" aria-label="${tos} timeouts left">${[0,1,2].map(i=>`<i class="${i<tos?"":"used"}"></i>`).join("")}</div>`:""}</div>`;
  };
  const stx = statusText(e), per = isFB() ? stx.long : (stx.per ? stx.long : (st.type.detail || st.type.shortDetail || ""));
  const bc = barColors(a,h);
  const ticking = st.type.state==="in" && !stx.brk && (isFB() || !!stx.per);
  // Basketball: who has the ball, under the clock (worked out from the latest plays).
  const bt = SPORT.tile==="bb" && st.type.state==="in" && !stx.brk ? [a,h].find(t=>t.team.id===pid) : null;
  const ballTag = bt ? `<div class="balltag"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>${esc(nameOf(bt.team))} ball</div>` : "";
  let html = `<div class="score" style="--away:${bc[0]};--home:${bc[1]}">${side(a,"away")}<div class="mid"><div class="clock">${ticking?`<span data-clk="${e.id}">${liveClock(e)}</span>`:""}</div><div class="per">${st.type.state==="pre"?fmtTime(e.date):esc(per)}</div>${ballTag}</div>${side(h,"home")}</div>`;
  if(!isFB()) html += otherDetails(e, sum, a, h, bc);
  else if(st.type.state==="in"){
    const pills = [];
    if(goodDD(sit.downDistanceText)) pills.push(`<span class="pill">${esc(sit.downDistanceText)}</span>`);
    if(sit.isRedZone) pills.push(`<span class="pill rz">Red zone</span>`);
    if(pills.length) html += `<div class="sit">${pills.join("")}</div>`;
    html += fieldView(sit, a, h, pid, e.id);
  }
  // Everything below (team stats, last play, win probability, play-by-play, radio) sits in one
  // "Game details" fold that starts closed; opening it is remembered.
  const detailsOpen = store.get("details") === "1";
  html += `<div class="details"><button class="label pbp-toggle" id="detailsToggle" aria-expanded="${detailsOpen}">Details<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button><div class="details-in"${detailsOpen ? "" : " hidden"}>`;
  if(!isFB()) html += statBars(sum, a, h, bc);
  const lp = isFB() ? (sit.lastPlay?.text || lastPlayFrom(sum)) : (st.type.state==="in" ? (lastPlayFrom(sum) || sit.lastPlay?.text) : null);
  if(lp) html += `<div class="last"><p class="label">Last play</p>${esc(lp)}</div>`;
  const wp = sum?.winprobability; if(wp?.length){ const hp = wp[wp.length-1].homeWinPercentage*100;
    html += `<div class="wp"><p class="label">Win probability</p><div class="wpbar"><span style="width:${100-hp}%;background:${bc[0]}"></span><span style="width:${hp}%;background:${bc[1]}"></span></div><div class="wpl"><span>${a.team.abbreviation} ${(100-hp).toFixed(1)}%</span><span>${h.team.abbreviation} ${hp.toFixed(1)}%</span></div></div>`; }
  html += isFB() ? playsView(sum) : otherPlays(sum);
  const r = radioFor(e);
  html += `<div class="radio-info"><p class="label">Radio for this game</p>${r.map(x=>{ const st = x.station && !/radio$/i.test(x.net||"") ? String(x.station).replace(/\s*\(no free online stream found\)/,"") : "";
    return `<div class="ri"><div class="rh"><b>${esc(x.team)}</b><span class="rchip ${x.stream ? "ok" : ""}">${x.stream ? "Free stream" : "No free stream"}</span></div><span>${esc(x.net||"")}${st ? ` · ${esc(st)}` : ""}</span></div>`; }).join("")}
  <span class="note">${isFB() ? "Each team's own radio broadcast. If one won't connect, try the other team's call." : SPORT.tile==="bb" ? "Each school's sports radio station, which carries basketball for most teams. If one isn't on the game, try the other team's." : `Each school's main sports radio station. Many carry ${SPORT.name.toLowerCase()}, but some are on a different game or show, so try the other team's if one isn't.`}</span></div></div></div>`;
  const same = html.replace(/(<span data-clk="[^"]*">)[^<]*/g, "$1") === (renderBoard.last||"");
  renderBoard.last = html.replace(/(<span data-clk="[^"]*">)[^<]*/g, "$1");
  if(same && B.innerHTML){ B.querySelectorAll("[data-clk]").forEach(el=>{ const g = events.find(x=>x.id===el.dataset.clk); if(g) el.textContent = liveClock(g); }); return; }
  const keep = B.querySelector(".plays")?.scrollTop || 0;
  B.innerHTML = html;
  const pl = B.querySelector(".plays"); if(pl && keep) pl.scrollTop = keep;
  const dt = $("#detailsToggle"); if(dt) dt.onclick = ()=>{ const open = dt.getAttribute("aria-expanded")!=="true"; store.set("details", open?"1":"0"); dt.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open)); dt.nextElementSibling.hidden = !open; };
  const pt = $("#pbpToggle"); if(pt) pt.onclick = ()=>{ const open = pt.getAttribute("aria-expanded")!=="true"; store.set("pbp", open?"1":"0"); pt.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open)); pt.nextElementSibling.hidden = !open; };
  B.querySelectorAll("[data-play]").forEach(l=>l.onclick=ev=>{ev.preventDefault(); $("#station").value = "team:"+l.dataset.play; startStation();});
}
function esc(s){return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c]))}
const DARK = matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)");
// ESPN has a dark-background version of most logos; fall back to the normal one if it's missing.
// Dark-mode logos that don't exist are remembered, so they aren't asked for again on every redraw.
const noDark = new Set();
function logoSrc(tm){ const u = tm.logo||""; return DARK.matches && /\/500\//.test(u) && !noDark.has(u) ? u.replace("/500/","/500-dark/") : u; }
// Teams outside Division I have no ESPN logo: show their initials in a gray disc instead of an empty box.
function noLogo(tm){ const n = (tm.shortDisplayName||tm.location||tm.abbreviation||"?").replace(/\(.*?\)/g,"").trim();
  const ini = (n.split(/\s+/).filter(w=>/^[A-Za-z]/.test(w)).map(w=>w[0]).join("").slice(0,2) || n.slice(0,2)).toUpperCase();
  return "data:image/svg+xml,"+encodeURIComponent(`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="11.5" fill="#8A95A3" fill-opacity=".28"/><text x="12" y="15.6" text-anchor="middle" font-family="system-ui,sans-serif" font-size="${ini.length>1?9.5:11}" font-weight="700" fill="#8A95A3">${ini.replace(/[<&]/g,"")}</text></svg>`); }
function logoImg(tm){ if(!tm.logo) return `<img src="${noLogo(tm)}" alt="">`; const u = tm.logo||"", d = logoSrc(tm); return `<img src="${d}" alt="" loading="lazy" decoding="async"${d!==u?` data-f="${u}" onerror="this.onerror=null;noDark.add(this.dataset.f);this.src=this.dataset.f"`:""}>`; }
// Names ESPN sends in all caps ("FT LAUDERDALE") read better in title case.
function nameOf(tm){ const n = tm.shortDisplayName||tm.location||""; return /[a-z]/.test(n) || n.length<5 ? n : n.replace(/[A-Z]{4,}/g, w=>w[0]+w.slice(1).toLowerCase()); }
function lum(hex){ const m=/^#?([0-9a-f]{6})$/i.exec(hex||""); if(!m) return null; const v=[0,2,4].map(i=>{const c=parseInt(m[1].slice(i,i+2),16)/255; return c<=.03928?c/12.92:((c+.055)/1.055)**2.4}); return .2126*v[0]+.7152*v[1]+.0722*v[2]; }
function cdist(x,y){ const p=h=>[0,2,4].map(i=>parseInt(h.slice(i,i+2),16)); try{ const a=p(x),b=p(y); return Math.hypot(a[0]-b[0],a[1]-b[1],a[2]-b[2]); }catch(e){ return 999; } }
// Team colors for bars, swapped for the alternate color when the main one would vanish
// into the background (black on dark, white on light) or match the other team.
// Teams ESPN has no colors for (many hockey and smaller schools): read them from the logo.
// The two strongest colors in the image are kept on this device, so it's done once per team.
const logoColors = (()=>{ try{ return JSON.parse(store.get("logoColors")||"{}"); }catch(e){ return {}; } })();
const logoPending = new Set();
function logoColorsFor(tm){
  if(!tm?.id || !tm.logo || logoColors[tm.id] || logoPending.has(tm.id)) return;
  logoPending.add(tm.id);
  const img = new Image(); img.crossOrigin = "anonymous";
  img.onload = ()=>{
    try{
      const N = 40, cv = document.createElement("canvas"); cv.width = cv.height = N;
      const cx = cv.getContext("2d", {willReadFrequently: true}); cx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, N, N);
      const px = cx.getImageData(0, 0, N, N).data, bins = new Map();
      for(let i = 0; i < px.length; i += 4){
        const r = px[i], g = px[i+1], b = px[i+2], al = px[i+3];
        if(al < 200 || (r > 232 && g > 232 && b > 232)) continue;          // transparent or white
        const mx = Math.max(r,g,b), mn = Math.min(r,g,b), sat = mx ? (mx-mn)/mx : 0;
        const k = (r>>5)<<6 | (g>>5)<<3 | (b>>5);
        const v = bins.get(k) || {n:0, w:0, r:0, g:0, b:0};
        const w = 1 + 2*sat;                                               // favor real colors over gray and black
        v.n++; v.w += w; v.r += r; v.g += g; v.b += b; bins.set(k, v);
      }
      const hex = v => [v.r, v.g, v.b].map(x => Math.round(x/v.n).toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join("").toUpperCase();
      const total = [...bins.values()].reduce((t,v)=>t+v.n, 0);
      const top = [...bins.values()].filter(v=>v.n >= Math.max(6, total*0.04)).sort((x,y)=>y.w-x.w).map(hex);  // ignore anti-aliased edges
      const out = []; for(const c of top){ if(out.every(o=>cdist(o,c) > 90)) out.push(c); if(out.length===2) break; }
      logoColors[tm.id] = out.length ? out : ["none"];
      store.set("logoColors", JSON.stringify(logoColors));
      renderBoard.last = ""; render();
    }catch(e){ logoColors[tm.id] = ["none"]; }  // image not readable (no CORS): keep the neutral colors
  };
  img.onerror = ()=>{ logoPending.delete(tm.id); };
  img.src = tm.logo;
}
function barColors(a, h){
  const ok = c => { const L = lum(c); return L!=null && (DARK.matches ? L>0.035 : L<0.8); };
  const fromLogo = tm => { if(!tm.color) logoColorsFor(tm); return (logoColors[tm.id]||[]).filter(c=>c!=="none"); };
  const pick = (tm, avoid) => [tm.color, tm.alternateColor, ...fromLogo(tm)].find(c => ok(c) && (!avoid || cdist(c,avoid)>90)) || (ok(tm.color)?tm.color:null);
  let ac = pick(a.team), hc = pick(h.team, ac);
  ac = ac || (DARK.matches?"8A94A3":"5B6573"); hc = hc || (DARK.matches?"C9D1DB":"AAB3BF");
  if(cdist(ac,hc) < 60) hc = DARK.matches?"C9D1DB":"AAB3BF";
  return ["#"+ac, "#"+hc];
}
function lastPlayFrom(sum){const p = sum?.drives ? sum.drives.current?.plays : realPlays(sum); return p?.length ? p[p.length-1].text : null}
// Baseball and softball log every pitch as a play; keep the ones that tell the story.
function realPlays(sum){
  return (sum?.plays||[]).filter(p=>p.text && !(SPORT.diamond && /^(ball|strike|foul|pitch|pickoff attempt|mound visit)\b/i.test(p.text)) && !/^(official tv timeout|end of game)$/i.test(p.text));
}
// Current set's points (volleyball): the last set in the line score.
function setPoints(e){
  const c = e.competitions[0], a = team(c,"away"), h = team(c,"home");
  const n = Math.max(a.linescores?.length||0, h.linescores?.length||0); if(!n) return null;
  return {n, a: a.linescores?.[n-1]?.value ?? 0, h: h.linescores?.[n-1]?.value ?? 0};
}
// Who has the ball. ESPN often leaves situation.possession empty (common right after
// kickoffs and in some games all night), so fall back to the current drive, then the last play.
// Basketball: ESPN doesn't say who has the ball, so work it out from the latest plays. A rebound or
// steal gives the ball to that team; a made basket (or last free throw) or a turnover gives it to
// the other team; after a miss the ball is loose until someone rebounds it.
function hoopsPoss(e, ids){
  const plays = snap(summaryHist, x=>x.id===e.id, delayP)?.s?.plays || [];
  for(let i = plays.length - 1; i >= Math.max(0, plays.length - 15); i--){
    const p = plays[i], t = String(p.team?.id || ""), txt = `${p.type?.text||""} ${p.text||""}`;
    if(/end of (the )?(1st|2nd|3rd|4th|first|second|half|game|quarter|period)|end period|end game/i.test(txt)) return null;
    if(!ids.includes(t)) continue;
    const other = ids.find(x=>x!==t);
    if(/rebound|steal/i.test(txt)) return t;
    if(/turnover|offensive foul|charge/i.test(txt)) return other;
    if(/free throw/i.test(txt)){
      const m = /(\d)\s*of\s*(\d)/i.exec(p.text||"");
      if(m && m[1] !== m[2]) return t;          // more free throws to come
      if(p.scoringPlay) return other;           // last one made
      return null;                              // last one missed: loose ball
    }
    if(p.scoringPlay) return other;
    if(/miss|block/i.test(txt)) return null;
    if(/timeout|foul|substitution|jump ball/i.test(txt)) continue;
  }
  return null;
}
function possId(e){
  const c = e.competitions[0], sit = c.situation||{}, ids = c.competitors.map(x=>x.team.id);
  if(sit.possession && ids.includes(sit.possession)) return sit.possession;
  if(!isFB()) return SPORT.tile==="bb" ? hoopsPoss(e, ids) : null;
  const sum = snap(summaryHist, x=>x.id===e.id, delayP)?.s, cur = sum?.drives?.current;
  const dt = cur?.team?.id || cur?.team;
  if(cur && !cur.end?.text && dt && ids.includes(String(dt))) return String(dt);
  const lp = sit.lastPlay, lt = lp?.team?.id;
  if(lt && ids.includes(lt)){
    const kick = /kickoff|punt|kick\b|field goal|extra point|\bpat\b/i.test((lp.type?.text||"")+" "+(lp.text||""));
    return kick ? ids.find(i=>i!==lt) : lt;
  }
  return null;
}
const lastSpot = {};
function fieldView(sit, a, h, pid, gid){
  // ESPN yardLine: 0-100 from home end zone? Use yardsToEndzone + possession for direction.
  if(!sit || (sit.yardLine==null && !sit.possessionText && !sit.downDistanceText && lastSpot[gid]==null)) return "";
  const homePoss = pid===h.team.id;
  // Place line of scrimmage: away goal on left (0), home goal on right (100). Away drives right.
  // Work out the spot from the clearest source available: "TTU 5" style text first (possession
  // text, then down-and-distance, then the last play), then yards-to-goal; during timeouts and
  // reviews ESPN often drops these, so keep the last good spot for the game.
  const abbr = t => (t.team.abbreviation||"").toUpperCase();
  // Play text doesn't always use ESPN's abbreviation ("UALB 28" for Albany, whose abbreviation is ALB),
  // so also match the start of the school or nickname, or one abbreviation inside the other.
  const flat = x => String(x||"").toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z&]/g,"");
  const whichSide = tok => { tok = tok.toUpperCase();
    const exact = [a,h].find(t=>abbr(t)===tok); if(exact) return exact;
    const loose = [a,h].filter(t=>[t.team.location,t.team.shortDisplayName,t.team.displayName,t.team.name].some(n=>flat(n).startsWith(tok)) || (abbr(t) && (tok.includes(abbr(t)) || abbr(t).includes(tok))));
    return loose.length===1 ? loose[0] : null; };
  const spot = txt => { const m = /(?:^|\bat\s+|\bthe\s+)([A-Z][A-Z&]{1,5})\s?0?(\d{1,2})\b/i.exec(txt||""); if(!m) return null;
    const side = whichSide(m[1]); if(!side) return null; const n = +m[2]; if(n>50) return null;
    return side===a ? n : 100 - n; }; // "KENT 21" = 21 yards from Kent's (left) goal
  let pos = spot((sit.possessionText||"").trim()) ?? spot(sit.downDistanceText);
  if(pos==null && sit.yardsToEndzone!=null && pid) pos = homePoss ? sit.yardsToEndzone : 100 - sit.yardsToEndzone;
  if(pos==null){ const lp = sit.lastPlay?.text || ""; const all = [...lp.matchAll(/\bto the ([A-Z&]{2,6})\s?0?(\d{1,2})\b/gi)]; if(all.length) pos = spot(`at ${all[all.length-1][1]} ${all[all.length-1][2]}`); }
  if(pos==null) pos = lastSpot[gid] ?? null;
  if(pos==null) return "";
  if(gid) lastSpot[gid] = pos;
  const toPct = y => 8 + (y/100)*84;
  const fdY = sit.distance && pid ? (homePoss ? pos - sit.distance : pos + sit.distance) : null;
  const [ca, ch] = barColors(a, h);
  const ez = (t, c, side) => `<div class="ez ${side}" style="--ez:${c}" title="${esc(t.team.abbreviation||"")}">${t.team.logo?`<img src="${t.team.logo}" alt="${esc(t.team.abbreviation||"")}">`:`<span>${esc(t.team.abbreviation||"")}</span>`}</div>`;
  // Yard lines every 5 yards (bolder every 10) and numbers 10-50-10.
  let marks = "";
  for(let y=5; y<100; y+=5) marks += `<i class="yl ${y%10?"":"ten"} ${y===50?"fifty":""}" style="left:${toPct(y)}%"></i>`;
  for(let y=10; y<100; y+=10) marks += `<b class="yn" style="left:${toPct(y)}%">${y<=50?y:100-y}</b>`;
  const dir = pid ? (homePoss ? -1 : 1) : 0; // away team drives right
  const togo = fdY!=null && fdY>0 && fdY<100 ? `<div class="togo" style="left:${toPct(Math.min(pos,fdY))}%;width:${Math.abs(fdY-pos)*0.84}%"></div><div class="fd" style="left:${toPct(fdY)}%"></div>` : "";
  const rz = sit.isRedZone && dir ? `<div class="rz" style="left:${toPct(dir>0?80:0)}%;width:${20*0.84}%"></div>` : "";
  return `<div class="field" aria-label="Ball on the ${esc(sit.possessionText||"")}">${ez(a,ca,"l")}${ez(h,ch,"r")}<div class="turf"></div>${rz}${marks}${togo}
  <div class="ls" style="left:${toPct(pos)}%"></div>
  <div class="ball ${dir<0?"rev":""}" style="left:${toPct(pos)}%"><svg viewBox="0 0 28 16" aria-hidden="true"><ellipse cx="13" cy="8" rx="11" ry="6.5" fill="#8B4A1F" stroke="#5A2C0E" stroke-width="1"/><path d="M6.5 8h13M10 6v4M12.2 6v4M14.4 6v4M16.6 6v4" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>${dir?'<path d="M25 4.5l3 3.5-3 3.5" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>':""}</svg></div></div>`;
}
function playsView(sum){
  const d = sum?.drives; if(!d) return "";
  const drives = [...(d.previous||[])]; if(d.current && !drives.some(x=>x.id===d.current.id)) drives.push(d.current);
  if(!drives.length) return "";
  const out = drives.slice().reverse().slice(0,8).map(dr=>{
    const plays = (dr.plays||[]).slice().reverse().map(p=>`<div class="play ${p.scoringPlay?"scoring":""}"><span class="t">Q${p.period?.number||""} ${p.clock?.displayValue||""}</span><span class="tx">${esc(p.text||"")}${p.start?.downDistanceText?`<span class="dd">${p.start.downDistanceText}</span>`:""}</span></div>`).join("");
    return `<div class="drive"><span>${dr.team?.shortDisplayName||dr.team?.abbreviation||""} drive${dr.displayResult?` · ${dr.displayResult}`:""}</span><span class="note">${dr.description||""}</span></div>${plays}`;
  }).join("");
  const open = store.get("pbp") !== "0";
  return `<div><button class="label pbp-toggle" id="pbpToggle" aria-expanded="${open}">Play by play<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button><div class="plays" ${open?"":"hidden"}>${out}</div></div>`;
}
/* ---------- other sports' game details ---------- */
const ordN = n => n + ((n%100>=11 && n%100<=13) ? "th" : ({1:"st",2:"nd",3:"rd"})[n%10] || "th");
function otherDetails(e, sum, a, h, bc){
  const c = e.competitions[0], sit = c.situation || {}, live = e.status.type.state === "in";
  let html = "";
  // Volleyball: the current set's score.
  if(SPORT.sets && live){ const s = setPoints(e); if(s) html += `<div class="sit"><span class="pill">Set ${s.n}: ${esc(a.team.abbreviation||"")} ${s.a} – ${esc(h.team.abbreviation||"")} ${s.h}</span></div>`; }
  // Baseball / softball: runners, count and who's up.
  if(SPORT.diamond && live && (sit.outs!=null || sit.balls!=null)){
    const b = (on, x, y) => `<i class="${on?"on":""}" style="left:${x}px;top:${y}px"></i>`;
    const dots = (n, max) => Array.from({length:max}, (_, i)=>`<b class="${i<n?"on":""}"></b>`).join("");
    const who = [sit.batter?.athlete && `<span>At bat<br><b>${esc(sit.batter.athlete.shortName||sit.batter.athlete.displayName||"")}</b></span>`, sit.pitcher?.athlete && `<span>Pitching<br><b>${esc(sit.pitcher.athlete.shortName||sit.pitcher.athlete.displayName||"")}</b></span>`].filter(Boolean).join("");
    html += `<div class="diamond"><div class="bases" role="img" aria-label="Runners: ${[sit.onFirst&&"first",sit.onSecond&&"second",sit.onThird&&"third"].filter(Boolean).join(", ")||"none"}">${b(sit.onSecond,28,4)}${b(sit.onThird,5,27)}${b(sit.onFirst,51,27)}</div>
      <div class="cnt"><span>B ${dots(sit.balls||0, 3)}</span><span>S ${dots(sit.strikes||0, 2)}</span><span>O ${dots(sit.outs||0, 2)}</span></div>${who?`<div class="who">${who}</div>`:""}</div>`;
  }
  // Basketball: the last few shots on a real half court.
  if(SPORT.court && live && sum) html += courtView(sum, a, h, bc);
  if(SPORT.tile==="hk" && e.status.type.state!=="pre") html += rinkView(e, a, h, bc);
  html += lineScore(e, a, h);
  return html;
}
// Hockey: ESPN only has goals per period and the clock for college hockey, so the rink shows those.
function rinkView(e, a, h, bc){
  const st = e.status, per = st.period || 0, live = st.type.state === "in";
  const pName = i => i < 3 ? String(i+1) : (i === 3 ? "OT" : `${i-2}OT`);
  const pucks = (t, c) => (t.linescores||[]).flatMap((l, i) => Array.from({length: Math.max(0, Math.round(+l.value || 0))}, () =>
    `<span class="puck" style="--c:${c}" title="Goal in period ${pName(i)}">${pName(i)}</span>`)).join("");
  const sec = toSec(st.displayClock), len = per > 3 ? 5*60 : 20*60;
  const done = live && sec != null ? Math.min(100, Math.max(0, (len - sec) / len * 100)) : (live ? 0 : 100);
  const mid = live ? (/intermission|end of/i.test(st.type.shortDetail||"") ? `<small>INT</small>${esc(st.type.shortDetail.replace(/\s*intermission/i,"")).replace(/^end of\s+/i, "End of<br>")}` : `<small>PERIOD</small>${per > 3 ? pName(per-1) : ordN(per)}`) : `<small>FINAL</small>${per > 3 ? pName(per-1) : ""}`;
  const side = (t, c, k) => `<div class="side ${k}">${t.team.logo ? `<img src="${logoSrc(t.team)}" alt="">` : ""}<div class="pucks">${pucks(t, c)}</div></div>`;
  return `<div class="rink" role="img" aria-label="Goals by period: ${esc(a.team.abbreviation||"")} ${esc(a.score)}, ${esc(h.team.abbreviation||"")} ${esc(h.score)}">
    <i class="zone l" style="--c:${bc[0]}"></i><i class="zone r" style="--c:${bc[1]}"></i>
    <i class="gl" style="left:9%"></i><i class="gl" style="right:9%"></i>
    <i class="ln" style="left:34%;background:var(--blue)"></i><i class="ln" style="left:66%;background:var(--blue)"></i><i class="ln" style="left:50%;background:var(--red)"></i>
    <i class="crease l"></i><i class="crease r"></i>
    ${side(a, bc[0], "l")}${side(h, bc[1], "r")}
    <div class="cc">${mid}</div>
    ${live ? `<div class="prog" aria-hidden="true"><i style="width:${done.toFixed(0)}%"></i></div>` : ""}
  </div>`;
}
/* Basketball court: drawn to NCAA dimensions (10 units = 1 foot), the home team's floor (lane in
   their color, their name on the baseline, their logo on the floor). The last 8 shots: solid = made,
   ring = missed, in each team's color; older shots fade and the newest one is labeled.
   ESPN's shot coordinates are in feet: x across the court (0-50), y out from the rim. */
// "Darius Washington III makes free throw 2 of 2" -> "Washington"
function shooterName(text){
  const w = String(text||"").split(/\s+(?:makes|misses|blocks)\b/i)[0].trim().split(/\s+/);
  return /^(jr\.?|sr\.?|ii|iii|iv)$/i.test(w[w.length-1]||"") ? w[w.length-2] : w[w.length-1];
}
function courtView(sum, a, h, bc){
  const isFT = p => /free throw/i.test(`${p.type?.text||""} ${p.text||""}`);
  // The latest trip to the line, if nothing has been shot from the floor since: "Washington FT 1 of 2"
  const trip = [];
  for(const p of realPlays(sum).slice().reverse()){ if(!p.shootingPlay) continue; if(!isFT(p)) break; if(trip.length && String(p.team?.id)!==String(trip[0].team?.id)) break; trip.unshift(p); }
  // ...and only for 30 seconds after the last one (by the game feed's clock, as you're seeing it).
  const ftAt = Date.parse(trip[trip.length-1]?.wallclock||"");
  if(trip.length && (isNaN(ftAt) || Date.now() - delayP*1000 - ftAt > 30000)) trip.length = 0;
  const shots = realPlays(sum).filter(p=>p.shootingPlay && !/free throw/i.test(`${p.type?.text||""} ${p.text||""}`) && p.coordinate &&
    p.coordinate.x>=-1 && p.coordinate.x<=51 && p.coordinate.y>=-3 && p.coordinate.y<=60).slice(-8);
  if(!shots.length) return "";
  const RIM = 52.5, home = bc[1], dark = `color-mix(in srgb, ${home} 78%, #000)`;
  const X = x => Math.max(8, Math.min(492, x*10)), Y = y => Math.max(-4, Math.min(326, RIM + y*10));
  const col = p => String(p.team?.id)===String(h.team.id) ? bc[1] : bc[0];
  const L = 'stroke="#fff" stroke-opacity=".92" stroke-width="3" fill="none"';
  const n = shots.length;
  const marks = shots.map((p, i)=>{
    const x = X(p.coordinate.x), y = Y(p.coordinate.y), c = col(p), op = (0.4 + 0.6*(i+1)/n).toFixed(2), last = i === n-1 && !trip.length;
    const halo = last ? `<circle class="halo" cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="10" fill="none" stroke="${c}" stroke-width="3"/>` : "";
    const dot = p.scoringPlay
      ? `<circle cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="${last?11:9}" fill="${c}" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2.5" opacity="${op}"/>`
      : `<circle cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="${last?10:8}" fill="rgba(0,0,0,.28)" stroke="${c}" stroke-width="3.5" opacity="${op}"/>`;
    return `<g><title>${esc(p.text||"")}</title>${halo}${dot}</g>`;
  }).join("");
  // Label the newest shot: "Hidalgo 3PT ✓" / "Bascoe 12-ft ✗"
  const lp = shots[n-1], last = shooterName(lp.text);
  const ft = /(\d+)-foot/i.exec(lp.text||""), three = /three point/i.test(lp.text||"");
  const label = `${last||""} ${three ? "3PT" : ft ? ft[1]+"-ft" : ""} ${lp.scoringPlay ? "✓" : "✗"}`.replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();
  const lw = label.length*8.6 + 20, lx = Math.max(lw/2 + 6, Math.min(494 - lw/2, X(lp.coordinate.x)));
  const ly = Y(lp.coordinate.y) < 46 ? Y(lp.coordinate.y) + 30 : Y(lp.coordinate.y) - 28;
  const tag = `<g transform="translate(${lx.toFixed(1)},${ly.toFixed(1)})"><rect x="${(-lw/2).toFixed(1)}" y="-13" width="${lw.toFixed(1)}" height="26" rx="13" fill="rgba(15,20,26,.86)"/><rect x="${(-lw/2).toFixed(1)}" y="-13" width="5" height="26" rx="2.5" fill="${col(lp)}"/><text x="3" y="5" text-anchor="middle" fill="#fff" font-family="Barlow Condensed, Barlow, sans-serif" font-weight="700" font-size="16" letter-spacing=".3">${esc(label)}</text></g>`;
  let ftMark = "";
  if(trip.length){
    const c = col(trip[0]), made = trip.filter(p=>p.scoringPlay).length, of = +(/of\s+(\d)/i.exec(trip[trip.length-1].text||"")||[])[1] || trip.length;
    const label = `${shooterName(trip[0].text)||""} FT ${made} of ${Math.max(of, trip.length)}`;
    const w = label.length*8.6 + 20;
    const dots = trip.map((p, i)=>{ const x = 250 + (i - (trip.length-1)/2)*26;
      return p.scoringPlay ? `<circle cx="${x}" cy="190" r="9" fill="${c}" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2.5"/>` : `<circle cx="${x}" cy="190" r="8" fill="rgba(0,0,0,.28)" stroke="${c}" stroke-width="3.5"/>`; }).join("");
    ftMark = `<g><title>${esc(trip.map(p=>p.text||"").join(" · "))}</title>${dots}<g transform="translate(250,224)"><rect x="${(-w/2).toFixed(1)}" y="-13" width="${w.toFixed(1)}" height="26" rx="13" fill="rgba(15,20,26,.86)"/><rect x="${(-w/2).toFixed(1)}" y="-13" width="5" height="26" rx="2.5" fill="${c}"/><text x="3" y="5" text-anchor="middle" fill="#fff" font-family="Barlow Condensed, Barlow, sans-serif" font-weight="700" font-size="16" letter-spacing=".3">${esc(label)}</text></g></g>`;
  }
  const name = esc(String(nameOf(h.team)||h.team.location||"").toUpperCase());
  const logo = h.team.logo ? `<image href="${esc(logoSrc(h.team))}" x="200" y="205" width="100" height="100" opacity=".2" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/>` : "";
  const hash = [70,110,140,170].map(y=>`<line x1="178" y1="${y}" x2="190" y2="${y}" ${L}/><line x1="310" y1="${y}" x2="322" y2="${y}" ${L}/>`).join("");
  return `<figure class="court2"><svg viewBox="0 -30 500 365" role="img" aria-label="Last ${n} shots on the court">
    <defs>
      <pattern id="planks" width="40" height="365" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" y="-30">
        <rect width="40" height="365" fill="#C48650"/><rect x="20" width="20" height="340" fill="#BE7F49"/>
        <line x1="20" y1="0" x2="20" y2="340" stroke="rgba(80,40,10,.18)" stroke-width="1"/><line x1="40" y1="0" x2="40" y2="340" stroke="rgba(80,40,10,.18)" stroke-width="1"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="90" x2="20" y2="90" stroke="rgba(80,40,10,.16)"/><line x1="20" y1="210" x2="40" y2="210" stroke="rgba(80,40,10,.16)"/><line x1="0" y1="300" x2="20" y2="300" stroke="rgba(80,40,10,.16)"/>
      </pattern>
      <radialGradient id="courtVig" cx="50%" cy="25%" r="80%"><stop offset="55%" stop-color="#000" stop-opacity="0"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000" stop-opacity=".32"/></radialGradient>
      <linearGradient id="courtGloss" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#fff" stop-opacity=".14"/><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#fff" stop-opacity="0"/></linearGradient>
    </defs>
    <rect x="0" y="-30" width="500" height="365" fill="url(#planks)"/>
    <rect x="0" y="-30" width="500" height="30" style="fill:${dark}"/>
    <text x="250" y="-9" text-anchor="middle" fill="#fff" font-family="Barlow Condensed, Barlow, sans-serif" font-weight="700" font-size="17" letter-spacing="7" opacity=".95">${name}</text>
    <rect x="190" y="0" width="120" height="190" style="fill:${home}" opacity=".62"/>
    ${logo}
    <rect x="1.5" y="0" width="497" height="345" ${L}/>
    <rect x="190" y="0" width="120" height="190" ${L}/>
    <path d="M190 190 A60 60 0 0 0 310 190" ${L}/>
    <path d="M190 190 A60 60 0 0 1 310 190" ${L} stroke-dasharray="9 8"/>
    <path d="M210 ${RIM} A40 40 0 0 0 290 ${RIM}" ${L}/>
    <path d="M33.5 0 V99.1 A221.5 221.5 0 0 0 466.5 99.1 V0" ${L}/>
    ${hash}
    <line x1="220" y1="40" x2="280" y2="40" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="250" cy="${RIM}" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#FF6A1A" stroke-width="3.5"/>
    <rect x="0" y="-30" width="500" height="365" fill="url(#courtVig)"/>
    <rect x="0" y="-30" width="500" height="365" fill="url(#courtGloss)"/>
    ${marks}${trip.length ? ftMark : tag}
  </svg>
  <figcaption class="courtkey"><span>Last ${n} shots</span><span class="mk"><b class="m"></b>Made<b class="x"></b>Missed</span><span class="tm"><i style="background:${bc[0]}"></i>${esc(a.team.abbreviation||"")}<i style="background:${bc[1]}"></i>${esc(h.team.abbreviation||"")}</span></figcaption></figure>`;
}
// Points per half / quarter / period / set / inning, with the total.
function lineScore(e, a, h){
  const n = Math.max(a.linescores?.length||0, h.linescores?.length||0);
  if(!n || e.status.type.state==="pre") return "";
  const reg = SPORT.diamond ? (SPORT.id==="sb" ? 7 : 9) : SPORT.sets ? 0 : SPORT.per==="H" ? 2 : SPORT.per==="Q" ? 4 : 3;
  const cols = Math.max(n, reg), cur = e.status.type.state==="in" ? n-1 : -1;
  const head = i => SPORT.sets ? `S${i+1}` : SPORT.diamond || i < reg ? String(i+1) : i === reg ? "OT" : `${i-reg+1}OT`;
  const val = (t, i) => { const v = t.linescores?.[i]?.value; return v==null ? (i < n ? "0" : "–") : (Number.isInteger(+v) ? String(+v) : esc(v)); };
  const extra = SPORT.diamond ? ["H","E"] : [];
  const ex = (t, k) => k==="H" ? (t.hits ?? "") : (t.errors ?? "");
  const row = t => `<tr><td>${esc(t.team.abbreviation||nameOf(t.team))}</td>${Array.from({length:cols},(_,i)=>`<td class="${i===cur?"cur":""}">${val(t,i)}</td>`).join("")}<td class="tot">${esc(t.score??"")}</td>${extra.map(k=>`<td>${esc(ex(t,k))}</td>`).join("")}</tr>`;
  return `<div class="lines"><table><thead><tr><th></th>${Array.from({length:cols},(_,i)=>`<th class="${i===cur?"cur":""}">${head(i)}</th>`).join("")}<th>${SPORT.sets?"Sets":SPORT.diamond?"R":"T"}</th>${extra.map(k=>`<th>${k}</th>`).join("")}</tr></thead><tbody>${row(a)}${row(h)}</tbody></table></div>`;
}
// Team stats from the box score, as side-by-side bars.
const STAT_ROWS = {
  bb: [["fieldGoalPct","Field goal %"],["threePointFieldGoalsMade-threePointFieldGoalsAttempted","3-pointers"],["totalRebounds","Rebounds"],["assists","Assists"],["turnovers","Turnovers"]],
  hk: [["shotsTotal","Shots on goal"],["saves","Saves"],["powerPlayGoals","Power-play goals"],["penaltyMinutes","Penalty minutes"],["faceoffsWon","Faceoffs won"]],
  vb: [["kills","Kills"],["aces","Aces"],["blocks","Blocks"],["digs","Digs"]],
};
function statBars(sum, a, h, bc){
  const want = STAT_ROWS[SPORT.tile]; const teams = sum?.boxscore?.teams; if(!want || !teams?.length) return "";
  const of = t => teams.find(x=>String(x.team?.id)===String(t.team.id))?.statistics || [];
  const sa = of(a), sh = of(h);
  const num = v => parseFloat(String(v||"").split("-")[0]) || 0;
  const rows = want.map(([k, label])=>{ const x = sa.find(s=>s.name===k), y = sh.find(s=>s.name===k); if(!x || !y) return "";
    const p = num(x.displayValue), q = num(y.displayValue);
    return `<span>${esc(x.displayValue)}</span><span class="sl">${label}<span class="sb"><span style="flex:${p||0.01};background:${bc[0]}"></span><span style="flex:${q||0.01};background:${bc[1]}"></span></span></span><span class="r">${esc(y.displayValue)}</span>`; }).join("");
  return rows ? `<div><p class="label">Team stats</p><div class="stats">${rows}</div></div>` : "";
}
function otherPlays(sum){
  const plays = realPlays(sum).slice(-40).reverse(); if(!plays.length) return "";
  const when = p => SPORT.diamond ? `${(p.period?.type||"").slice(0,3)} ${p.period?.number ? ordN(p.period.number) : ""}`.trim()
    : `${SPORT.per||""}${p.period?.number||""} ${p.clock?.displayValue||""}`.trim();
  const out = plays.map(p=>`<div class="play ${p.scoringPlay?"scoring":""}"><span class="t">${esc(when(p))}</span><span class="tx">${esc(p.text||"")}${p.awayScore!=null && p.scoringPlay?`<span class="dd">${p.awayScore}–${p.homeScore}</span>`:""}</span></div>`).join("");
  const open = store.get("pbp") !== "0";
  return `<div><button class="label pbp-toggle" id="pbpToggle" aria-expanded="${open}">Play by play<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button><div class="plays" ${open?"":"hidden"}>${out}</div></div>`;
}
function radioFor(e){
  return e.competitions[0].competitors.slice().sort((x,y)=>x.homeAway==="home"?1:-1).map(t=>{
    const info = RADIO_INFO[t.team.location];
    const r = RADIO[t.team.location] || {net: info?.network || `${t.team.location} radio`, station: (info?.flagship||"") + " (no free online stream found)", listen: info?.listen_page || ""};
    const saved = store.get("stream:"+t.team.location);
    return {team:t.team.location, ...r, stream: saved || (r.streams&&r.streams.length ? "auto" : null)};
  });
}

/* ---------- radio ---------- */
const NATIVE_HLS = (()=>{ try{ return !!document.createElement("audio").canPlayType("application/vnd.apple.mpegurl"); }catch(e){ return false; } })();
const audio = $("#audio"); let hls = null;
function fillStations(){
  const sel = $("#station"), teams = new Set();
  events.filter(e=>e.status.type.state==="in").forEach(e=>e.competitions[0].competitors.forEach(t=>{ if(RADIO[t.team.location] || store.get("stream:"+t.team.location)) teams.add(t.team.location); }));
  if(currentTeam) teams.add(currentTeam);
  const cur = sel.value;
  sel.innerHTML = `<option value="">Choose a team's radio…</option>` + [...teams].sort().map(t=>{
    const has = store.get("stream:"+t) || RADIO[t]?.streams?.length;
    return `<option value="team:${t}">${t}${has?"":" (needs URL)"}</option>`;}).join("");
  if(cur) sel.value = cur;
}
function suggestStation(){ const e = events.find(x=>x.id===selected); if(!e || !audio.paused) return;
  const home = team(e.competitions[0],"home").team.location; $("#station").value = "team:"+home; }
function startStation(){
  const v = $("#station").value; if(!v) return;
  const t = v.slice(5); if(RADIO[t]?.streams?.length || store.get("stream:"+t)){ listenTo(t); return; }
  const r = RADIO[t]||{}, saved = store.get("stream:"+t);
  const list = saved ? [saved, ...(r.streams||[])] : (r.streams||[]);
  if(list.length){ playList(list, r.net||t+" radio", r.station||""); return; }
  const url = null;
  if(!url){ $("#nowName").textContent = t; $("#nowSub").innerHTML = `No direct stream saved. <a href="${r.listen||"https://tunein.com/search/?query="+encodeURIComponent(t+" football")}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open the official listen page</a>.`; return; }
  play(url, r.net||t+" radio", r.station||url);
}
// Try each candidate stream in turn until one starts playing.
let tryToken = 0;
async function resolveCandidate(c){
  if(typeof c === "string") return [c];
  if(c.tunein){
    try{
      const r = await fetch(`https://opml.radiotime.com/Tune.ashx?id=${c.tunein}&render=json&formats=mp3,aac`);
      const j = await r.json(); return (j.body||[]).map(b=>b.url).filter(Boolean);
    }catch(e){ return []; }
  }
  return [];
}
let pending = null; // the station being connected: {token, loc, sub}
async function playList(list, name, sub, loc){
  const token = ++tryToken; pending = {token, loc, sub};
  $("#nowName").textContent = name; $("#nowSub").textContent = "Connecting…";
  for(const c of list){
    for(const url of await resolveCandidate(c)){
      if(token !== tryToken || deck) return;
      const ok = await tryUrl(url);
      if(token !== tryToken || deck) return;
      if(ok){ connected(loc, url, sub); return; }
    }
  }
  // Nothing answered within the timer, but the last stream is still loading: if it starts in the
  // next 20 seconds, treat that as success instead of leaving it playing behind an error message.
  const late = ()=>{ audio.removeEventListener("playing", late); if(token===tryToken && !deck){ const u = lastTried; connected(loc, u, sub); } };
  audio.addEventListener("playing", late);
  const giveUp = ()=>{
    const ext = loc && RADIO[loc]?.external;
    if(ext) $("#nowSub").innerHTML = `This station's stream won't play inside the page. <a href="${esc(ext)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open it in Safari</a>`;
    else $("#nowSub").textContent = "No stream answered. The station may not be on the air right now.";
    if(delay || delayP) setDelays(0, 0);
    if(loc) track(`listen-failed/${SPORT.id}/${loc}`, `Didn't connect: ${loc} (${SPORT.name})`);
  };
  setTimeout(()=>{ audio.removeEventListener("playing", late); if(token===tryToken && !deck){ try{ audio.pause(); audio.removeAttribute("src"); audio.load(); }catch(e){} currentTeam = null; giveUp(); render(); } }, 20000);
  connecting = null; render();
  $("#nowSub").textContent = "Slow to connect… still trying.";
}
let lastTried = null;
function connected(loc, url, sub){
  pending = null; lastProgress = Date.now();
  if(loc) track(`listen/${SPORT.id}/${loc}`, `Listen: ${loc} (${SPORT.g ? SPORT.g + " " : ""}${SPORT.name})`);
  deck = {loc, url, sub}; syncOnAir();
  // Each station keeps its own score delay: start from its saved value, or live, then let auto-sync refine it.
  pauseAdd = 0; syncPausedAt = 0; connectedAt = Date.now(); liveOnly = false; autoSync(); setTimeout(autoSync, 3000);
  $("#nowSub").textContent = sub;
  // Some streams play an ad to every new listener before the broadcast picks up.
  if(liveInfo[vKey(url)]?.preroll || /leanstream|ihrhls|revma/.test(url)) toast("The broadcast will start after a short ad.");
  connecting = null; render();
}
function tryUrl(url){
  lastTried = url;
  return new Promise(res=>{
    let done = false; const fin = v=>{ if(done) return; done = true; clearTimeout(tm); audio.removeEventListener("playing", onOk); audio.removeEventListener("error", onErr); audio.removeEventListener("timeupdate", onTime); res(v); };
    const onOk = ()=>fin(true), onErr = ()=>fin(false), tm = setTimeout(()=>fin(false), 8000);
    const onTime = ()=>{ if(audio.currentTime > 0 && !audio.paused){ audio.removeEventListener("timeupdate", onTime); fin(true); } };
    audio.addEventListener("playing", onOk); audio.addEventListener("error", onErr); audio.addEventListener("timeupdate", onTime);
    play(url, $("#nowName").textContent, "Connecting…");
  });
}
// SecureNet streams expect a per-listener session id during live events.
function withSession(url){
  if(!/securenetsystems\.net\//.test(url) || /playSessionID=/.test(url)) return url;
  const id = (crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : String(Math.random()).slice(2)).toUpperCase();
  return url + (url.includes("?") ? "&" : "?") + "playSessionID=" + id;
}
// hls.js is only needed where the browser can't play HLS itself (not on iPhone), so it loads on first use.
function loadHls(){
  if(window.Hls) return Promise.resolve();
  return loadHls.p || (loadHls.p = new Promise((res, rej)=>{ const sc = document.createElement("script");
    sc.src = "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/hls.js/1.5.13/hls.min.js"; sc.onload = res; sc.onerror = ()=>{ loadHls.p = null; rej(); }; document.head.appendChild(sc); }));
}
function play(url, name, sub){
  if(/\.m3u8(\?|$)/i.test(url) && !NATIVE_HLS && !window.Hls){
    loadHls().then(()=>{ if(lastTried === url) play(url, name, sub); }).catch(()=>audio.dispatchEvent(new Event("error")));
    $("#nowName").textContent = name; $("#nowSub").textContent = sub; return;
  }
  url = withSession(url);
  if(hls){hls.destroy(); hls=null}
  // Safari (iPhone/iPad/Mac) plays HLS itself and keeps lock-screen controls; other browsers need hls.js.
  // Use the browser's own HLS playback whenever it has it (every browser on iPhone, Safari on Mac):
  // it keeps playing in the background and on the lock screen. hls.js only where it's missing.
  const SAFARI = NATIVE_HLS;
  if(/\.m3u8(\?|$)/i.test(url) && !SAFARI && window.Hls && Hls.isSupported()){
    hls = new Hls(); hls.on(Hls.Events.ERROR, (ev, d)=>{ if(d.fatal) audio.dispatchEvent(new Event("error")); }); hls.loadSource(url); hls.attachMedia(audio);
  } else audio.src = url;
  audio.play().catch(()=>{});
  $("#nowName").textContent = name; $("#nowSub").textContent = sub;
}
$("#station").onchange = startStation;
$("#pp").onclick = ()=>{
  if(audio.src || hls){ audio.paused ? resumeRadio() : audio.pause(); return; }
  const e = events.find(x=>x.id===selected) || events.find(x=>x.status.type.state==="in");
  const t = e && e.competitions[0].competitors.map(c=>c.team.location).find(l=>RADIO[l]?.streams?.length || store.get("stream:"+l));
  if(t) listenTo(t); else toast("Tap Listen next to a team to start its radio.");
};

audio.onpause = ()=>{$("#pp").innerHTML='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 5.5v13a1 1 0 0 0 1.5.86l10.4-6.5a1 1 0 0 0 0-1.72L9.5 4.64A1 1 0 0 0 8 5.5z"/></svg>'; $("#pp").setAttribute("aria-label","Play radio")};
audio.onerror = ()=>{ if(connecting) return; if(deck) reconnect(); else $("#nowSub").textContent="Stream dropped. Tap Listen to reconnect."; };
/* Automatic reconnect: if the stream errors, or stops moving for 15 seconds while it should be playing,
   try the same stream again, then the team's other streams. Gives up after 4 tries in a row. */
let lastProgress = 0, lastTime = -1, reconnects = 0, reconnectAt = 0;
audio.addEventListener("timeupdate", ()=>{
  if(pending && pending.token===tryToken && !deck && !audio.paused && audio.currentTime > 0.5){ const p = pending; connected(p.loc, lastTried, p.sub); }
  if(audio.currentTime !== lastTime){ lastTime = audio.currentTime; lastProgress = Date.now(); }
  if(reconnects && Date.now() - reconnectAt > 60000) reconnects = 0; // a minute of good audio resets the count
});
setInterval(()=>{ if(deck && !connecting && !audio.paused && navigator.onLine !== false && Date.now() - lastProgress > 15000) reconnect(); }, 5000);
window.addEventListener("online", ()=>{ if(deck && !connecting && !audio.paused) reconnect(); });
function reconnect(){
  if(!deck || connecting) return;
  if(reconnects >= 4){ $("#nowSub").textContent = "Stream dropped. Tap Listen to reconnect."; reconnects = 0; deck = null; currentTeam = null; render(); return; }
  reconnects++; reconnectAt = Date.now();
  const {loc, url} = deck, r = RADIO[loc] || {};
  const rest = [...(ready[loc]||[]), ...(r.streams||[])].filter(u=>u && u!==url);
  currentTeam = loc; connecting = loc; deck = null; lastProgress = Date.now(); syncOnAir();
  playList([url, ...new Set(rest)], r.net || `${loc} radio`, r.station || "", loc);
  $("#nowSub").textContent = "Reconnecting…";
  render();
}
// After a long pause the stream is far behind live: start it fresh instead of resuming.
let pausedAt = 0;
audio.addEventListener("pause", ()=>{ pausedAt = Date.now(); });
// The audio falls behind by however long it was paused (unless it was restarted fresh).
audio.addEventListener("pause", ()=>{ syncPausedAt = Date.now(); });
audio.addEventListener("playing", ()=>{ if(syncPausedAt && deck){ pauseAdd += (Date.now() - syncPausedAt)/1000; } syncPausedAt = 0; });
function resumeRadio(){
  if(deck && pausedAt && Date.now() - pausedAt > 30000){ const loc = deck.loc; listenTo(loc); return; }
  audio.play().catch(()=>{});
}
$("#vol").oninput = e=> audio.volume = e.target.value;

// Live: stop holding scores for the radio until you sync again (or use − / +).
$("#goLive").onclick = ()=>{ liveOnly = true; matchedAt = 0; setDelays(0, 0); };
function setDelays(dS, dP){
  delay = Math.max(0, Math.min(150, dS)); delayP = Math.max(0, Math.min(150, dP));
  store.set("delay", delay); syncLabel(); render();
}
const setDelay = d => setDelays(d, d);
function syncLabel(){
  const tag = syncMode==="heard" ? " · matched" : syncMode==="stream" ? " · auto" : syncMode==="adjusted" ? " · set" : "";
  // Short enough to share one row with the buttons on a phone: "Held 29s ✓" / "Live".
  $("#delayV").textContent = (delay ? `Held ${delay}s` : "Live") + (matchedAt && matchedAt >= connectedAt ? " ✓" : "");
  $("#delayV").title = (delay ? `Scores held ${delay} seconds` : "Scores live") + tag;
  $("#goLive").classList.toggle("on", !delay && !delayP);
  // The bold "Radio-Score Sync" button in the radio bar: gold until this station is lined up, then a quiet "Synced ✓".
  // "Synced" only after you matched a play since this stream started: a saved setting from another
  // day or the stream's own clock is a starting guess, not a confirmed match.
  const pill = $("#syncPill"), on = !!deck && !!onAirGame(), done = !!matchedAt && matchedAt >= connectedAt;
  pill.hidden = !on; pill.classList.toggle("done", done);
  pill.innerHTML = done ? "<span>Synced ✓</span>" : "<span>Radio-Score</span><span>Sync</span>";
  pill.setAttribute("aria-label", done ? "Radio and scores are synced. Tap to sync again." : "Radio-Score Sync: line the scores up with the radio");
}
// − / +: move the radio's lag by 2 seconds and remember it for this station.
function nudgeSync(by){
  if(!deck) return;
  liveOnly = false;
  const g = onAirGame(), {sl} = lagsFor(g), R = radioLagNow() ?? (sl + delay);

}

// Pick up site updates without a manual refresh: every 5 minutes, check whether the page itself has
// changed. If the radio is off, reload quietly; if it's playing, offer a one-tap refresh instead.
(function watchForUpdates(){
  // Every 5 minutes, ask whether the page has changed (headers only, not the whole page).
  // A new version reloads quietly only while the page is out of sight and the radio is off;
  // otherwise a one-tap "Site updated" bar appears, so nothing is lost mid-use.
  let first = null, pending = false;
  const sig = async ()=>{
    try{
      const r = await fetch(location.pathname + "?v=" + Date.now(), {method:"HEAD", cache:"no-store"});
      const h = r.headers.get("etag") || r.headers.get("last-modified");
      if(h) return h;
      const t = await (await fetch(location.pathname + "?v=" + Date.now(), {cache:"no-store"})).text(); return t.length + ":" + t.slice(-400);
    }catch(e){ return null; }
  };
  const reloadNow = ()=>{ try{ sessionStorage.setItem("autoReload", "1"); }catch(e){} location.reload(); };
  const quiet = ()=> document.hidden && audio.paused && !connecting;
  sig().then(v=>first=v);
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", ()=>{ if(pending && quiet()) reloadNow(); });
  setInterval(async ()=>{
    if(pending) return;
    const v = await sig(); if(!v || !first || v===first) return;
    pending = true;
    if(quiet()){ reloadNow(); return; }
    if(!document.getElementById("updBar")){
      const b = document.createElement("button"); b.id = "updBar"; b.textContent = "Site updated · tap to refresh";
      b.onclick = ()=>location.reload(); document.body.appendChild(b);
    }
  }, 5*60*1000);
})();

  setDelay(0);
  loadDirectory();
  // Which sports are in season (and how many games each has live), every 5 minutes.
  checkSeasons(); setInterval(()=>{ if(!document.hidden) checkSeasons(); }, 15*60*1000);
  pollLoop();
  setInterval(()=>{ if(delay) render(); }, 1000); // step through held-back scores
})();
